About the Role
An established and growing national trade publication serving the construction, plumbing, artisan and broader trade markets is looking to appoint a highly driven Sales & Business Development Executive. This is a genuine new-business development role for someone who enjoys prospecting, opening doors, building relationships and converting commercial opportunities into revenue. The publication is approximately two years old and has already demonstrated strong commercial potential without previously having a dedicated salesperson or formal sales function. Advertising sales of approximately R155,000 have been achieved in a single month, despite sales historically being handled by existing team members alongside their primary responsibilities. The business is now investing in a dedicated sales function for the first time and is looking for someone who is excited by the opportunity to build, structure and grow the commercial side of the publication. This is not an account-management role where the successful candidate will inherit a mature book of business. The successful candidate will be expected to proactively generate opportunities, develop a pipeline and help build a professional, structured sales process.
The Opportunity
The successful candidate will have access to:
An existing prospect and contact database.
Historical sales information.
Active and warm opportunities already in the pipeline.
An established advertising rate card.
Existing industry contacts and market intelligence.
Sales and marketing material.
Support from management, editorial and the wider team.
However, proactive prospecting, cold outreach and building a personal pipeline will remain fundamental to the role. The business believes there is significant untapped opportunity within the market and is looking for someone who sees the potential in building towards meaningful long-term revenue growth.
Key Responsibilities
New Business Development
Proactively identify and develop new advertising and commercial opportunities.
Conduct cold calling, outbound prospecting and direct outreach to prospective advertisers.
Build relationships with companies operating within construction, plumbing, manufacturing, trade, industrial and related B2B markets.

Identify new sectors and advertiser categories that align with the publication's audience.

Manage opportunities through the full sales process from initial contact through to close.

Prospects.
Opportunities.
Follow-ups.
Expected revenue.
Forecast close dates.
Conversion activity.
Help establish a more structured and professional sales process within the business.
Contribute towards developing reliable data around sales cycles, conversion rates and pipeline performance.
Advertising & Commercial Sales

Clearly communicate the value and reach of the publication to prospective advertisers.
Understand client objectives and recommend suitable advertising solutions.
Prepare and present proposals and advertising options.
Negotiate professionally while protecting commercial value.
Close new advertising business.
Identify opportunities for repeat campaigns and longer-term advertising relationships.
Account Development
While new business is the primary focus, the successful candidate will also:
Maintain strong relationships with customers once business has been secured.
Encourage repeat advertising.
Identify upselling and additional commercial opportunities.
Maintain regular contact with advertisers.
Develop long-term relationships that contribute to recurring revenue.

Maintain disciplined records of sales activity.
Produce accurate sales forecasts.
Track conversion and pipeline progression.
Report regularly on:
New prospects.
Meetings.
Proposals.
Pipeline value.
Sales closed.
Expected revenue.
Identify market feedback, competitor activity and commercial opportunities.
Ideal Candidate Profile
We are looking for a genuine new-business salesperson, rather than someone whose experience is predominantly account management or servicing existing customers.
The ideal candidate will:
Have a strong hunter mentality.
Enjoy cold prospecting and opening new doors.
Be commercially minded and results-driven.
Have proven ability to generate their own pipeline.
Be confident engaging with business owners and senior decision-makers.
Be highly organised and disciplined with follow-up.
Demonstrate strong relationship-building capability.
Be comfortable working independently.
Take ownership of commercial outcomes.
Be motivated by uncapped earning potential.
Be excited by the opportunity to help build a sales function rather than simply inherit an established portfolio.
Experience
Relevant experience could include:
B2B sales.
Media sales.
Advertising sales.
Sponsorship sales.
Exhibition or event sales.
Business development.
Construction industry sales.
Plumbing or trade-sector sales.
Manufacturing or industrial sales.
Other commercially focused B2B environments.
Experience in media or publishing would be advantageous, but strong sales ability and proven new-business development capability are the priority.
Key Skills & Competencies
Proven new-business development ability.
Cold calling and outbound prospecting.
Lead generation.
Pipeline management.
Strong closing ability.
Commercial negotiation.
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Relationship management.
Proposal presentation.
Strong administration and follow-through.
Forecasting and reporting.
Ability to work independently.
High levels of resilience and persistence.
Strong commercial judgement.
Comfortable working towards clear revenue targets.
Working Arrangement
The role operates on a four-day working week, Monday to Thursday.
Fridays are generally kept free for personal administration and appointments, providing an attractive additional benefit alongside the basic salary and uncapped commission structure.
What Success Looks Like
The successful candidate will help establish a structured and sustainable sales function by:
Growing monthly advertising revenue.
Building a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.
Generating consistent new business.
Converting existing warm prospects.
Increasing repeat advertising revenue.
Developing new industry relationships.
Introducing disciplined pipeline management and follow-up.
Establishing reliable forecasting.
Tracking conversion rates and sales-cycle performance.
Helping the publication materially grow its commercial market share.
Why This Role Will Appeal
This is an opportunity to join a young and growing trade publication at a point where it is investing properly in sales for the first time. The successful candidate will have an existing foundation to work from, including market traction, active prospects, historical sales information, a rate card, industry contacts and management support. At the same time, there is significant opportunity for the right salesperson to build something meaningful, establish a professional sales function and directly influence the commercial growth of the business. It is particularly well suited to an ambitious salesperson who wants ownership, uncapped earning potential, a four-day working week and the opportunity to build rather than simply maintain an existing sales portfolio.

The successful candidate will supervise audit assignments, manage senior stakeholder relationships, develop audit team members and contribute to the ongoing improvement of the Internal Audit function.
Key Responsibilities
Audit Planning and Execution
• Lead and manage end-to-end internal audit engagements across multiple business areas.
• Develop risk-based audit programmes, scopes and testing strategies.
• Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Use data analysis to identify emerging risks, trends and potential control weaknesses.
• Ensure audit assignments are completed within agreed timelines and budgets.
Audit Reporting
• Prepare clear, high-quality audit reports for Executive Management and the Board Audit Committee.
• Articulate audit findings, root causes, risk implications and practical recommendations.
• Present audit observations and conclusions to senior management.
• Maintain consistency and quality across audit documentation and working papers.
Stakeholder Management
• Build credible and constructive relationships with business and support functions.
• Participate in management discussions concerning governance, risk and control matters.
• Provide advisory support on control design and regulatory requirements when requested, while maintaining Internal Audit's independence and objectivity.
Audit Quality and Team Development
• Ensure compliance with the organisation's Internal Audit methodology and applicable Global Internal Audit Standards, including the IPPF.
• Maintain high standards of audit quality, evidence and documentation.
• Review audit working papers prepared by audit team members.
• Coach, mentor and support the professional development of auditors.
• Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the Internal Audit function.
Regulatory and Compliance Assurance
Assess compliance with relevant legislation, regulations and internal requirements, including:
• Banking regulations and regulatory guidance.
• South African Reserve Bank requirements.
• Prudential Authority requirements.
• The Financial Intelligence Centre Act and related obligations.
• Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing requirements.
• Internal policies, procedures and control standards.
• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on the organisation and its control environment.
Follow-Up Reviews
• Monitor the implementation of agreed management actions.
• Conduct follow-up reviews to verify that findings have been appropriately remediated.
• Report overdue actions and significant control weaknesses to management and the Board Audit Committee.
Minimum Requirements
Qualifications
A bachelor's degree in one of the following or a closely related field:
• Internal Audit
• Accounting
• Finance
• Risk Management
• Commerce
Professional Certification
One or more of the following professional certifications would be advantageous:
• CIA - Certified Internal Auditor
• CA(SA) - Chartered Accountant South Africa
• CISA - Certified Information Systems Auditor
Experience
• A minimum of five years' Internal Audit experience.
• A minimum of three years' management or supervisory experience.
• Experience within banking, financial services, regulatory compliance or risk management environments.
• Strong working knowledge of AML/CFT, FICA and banking regulations.
• Proven experience engaging with Executive Management and Audit Committees.
Knowledge and Technical Skills
• Risk-based internal auditing
• Internal control frameworks
• Corporate governance
• AML/CFT and financial-crime controls
• Regulatory compliance
• Data analytics
• Audit report writing
• Root-cause analysis
• Process mapping

The Ideal Candidate
You are a commercially aware and principled audit professional who can balance independent challenge with constructive stakeholder engagement. You communicate complex risk and control matters clearly, maintain rigorous quality standards and enjoy developing others. You are equally comfortable working at a detailed technical level and presenting meaningful assurance to senior decision-makers.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
PLAY a critical role in ensuring the effective management of financial operations as the next Chief Financial Officer sought by a growing dynamic Investment and Commercial Property Management Firm. You will be responsible for overseeing all financial aspects of the business, including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, cash flow management, and ensuring compliance with relevant financial regulations. Within the property development environment, the CFO will play a vital role in project financing, investment structuring, and long-term capital planning. The successful incumbent must possess a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (CA(SA) or similar professional qualification with at least 5 years’ experience in a senior financial management role with a proven track record and a solid understanding of financial regulations and tax laws in South Africa.
DUTIES:
Prepare accurate and timely financial reports, including monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
Provide financial analysis and insights to support business decisions and strategic planning, particularly relating to property development projects and investments.
Monitor key financial metrics and performance indicators to ensure the financial health of the company.
Develop and manage the annual budget, working closely with Department Heads to ensure alignment with company goals.
Provide regular updates on financial performance versus budget and forecast, highlighting variances and recommending corrective actions.
Oversee cash flow management to ensure sufficient liquidity for day-to-day operations and project funding requirements.
Implement effective strategies for managing receivables and payables and ensuring timely payments.
Manage banking relationships and funding partners, including maintaining strong relationships with commercial banks, development finance institutions, and other lenders.
Negotiate banking facilities, oversee debt covenants, manage loan applications and drawdowns, and ensure optimal funding structures to support operational requirements and property development projects.
Ensure compliance with financial regulations, tax laws, and industry standards relevant to South Africa and the property development sector.
Coordinate with external auditors during the annual audit process.
Work closely with the management team to develop and implement long-term financial strategies, including funding structures and capital allocation.
Provide financial modelling and analysis to support business expansion, property acquisitions, investments, and cost management decisions.
Work cross-functionally with other departments within the organization, including intercompany transactions and loan structures.
REQUIREMENTS:
Qualifications -
Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field (CA(SA) or similar professional qualification preferred).
Experience/Skills -
Minimum of 5 years’ experience in a senior financial management role, ideally within a property development, manufacturing, or retail environment.
Proven track record of managing financial operations, including budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and compliance.
Strong understanding of financial regulations and tax laws in South Africa.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a strategic mindset.
Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across all levels of the organization.
Advantageous –
Experience with project-based accounting, property finance, or development funding structures.
ATTRIBUTES:
High level of integrity, professionalism, and attention to detail.
Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to present financial information clearly to both financial and non-financial stakeholders.
Results-driven, with a focus on continuous improvement and operational efficiency.
Commercially astute with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and mitigating risks.

About the position
We are seeking a Project Manager for a short term contract (3-6 months), onsite.
The Project Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering priority business projects within agreed scope, time, cost, quality, risk, and stakeholder expectations. The role provides structured project management discipline across business-as-usual, operational improvement, regulatory, reporting, risk, control, systems, and transformation-related initiatives.
The role requires strong delivery ownership, practical governance, disciplined planning, proactive issue resolution, and clear communication with senior stakeholders, project teams, business owners, vendors, and delivery partners.
Key Accountabilities
PROJECT PLANNING AND DELIVERY
Define project scope, objectives, deliverables, milestones, assumptions, dependencies, and success criteria.
Develop and maintain integrated project plans, delivery schedules, RAID logs, decision logs, and action trackers.
Coordinate delivery activities across business, finance, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and vendor teams.
Apply agile or scrum management practices where appropriate, including sprint planning, backlog coordination, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and impediment tracking.
Work with product owners, business leads, and delivery teams to prioritise work, clarify requirements, manage backlogs, and maintain delivery momentum.
Monitor progress against agreed timelines and proactively manage risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints.
Ensure project outputs are delivered to the required quality and are accepted by the appropriate business owners.
GOVERNANCE, REPORTING AND CONTROLS
Establish practical project governance appropriate to the scale, complexity, and risk profile of each initiative.
Prepare clear project status reports, steering committee packs, progress updates, and escalation summaries.
Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure decisions, approvals, dependencies, and risks are traceable.
Support audit readiness, control discipline, and compliance with relevant internal policies and delivery standards.
Escalate material risks, unresolved decisions, and delivery blockers in a timely and structured manner.
STAKEHOLDER AND CHANGE MANAGEMENT
Build effective working relationships with senior stakeholders, business owners, delivery teams, and external partners.
Translate project objectives, risks, decisions, and progress into clear, audience-appropriate communication.
Facilitate workshops, working sessions, governance forums, and delivery check-ins.
Support adoption of project outputs by coordinating communication, readiness activities, handover, and transition planning.
Manage expectations constructively and maintain alignment between project teams and business priorities.
PROCESS, SYSTEMS AND VENDOR COORDINATION
Coordinate activities involving process improvement, reporting, controls, data, technology, and operational change.
Work with system owners, vendors, and delivery partners to track commitments, resolve issues, and meet agreed service expectations.
Identify opportunities to simplify ways of working, reduce duplication, and improve delivery efficiency.
Support implementation planning, testing coordination, business readiness, cutover activities, and post-implementation stabilisation where required.
Minimum Requirements
QUALIFICATIONS AND CERTIFICATIONS
Relevant degree or diploma in business, finance, commerce, accounting, information systems, project management, or a related discipline.
Formal project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, Scrum Master, PMI-ACP, or equivalent is preferred.
Additional qualifications in change management, process improvement, Lean Six Sigma, risk management, or business analysis would be advantageous.
EXPERIENCE
Minimum of 5 years’ project management experience, preferably in finance, operations, insurance, banking, financial services, professional services, or a regulated business environment.
Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects with senior stakeholders and multiple delivery teams.
Experience delivering initiatives linked to reporting, controls, audit, compliance, risk, process improvement, systems, data, or operational change.
Experience working with agile, hybrid, or waterfall delivery methods, with the ability to tailor the approach to the project context.
SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
Strong project planning, coordination, governance, facilitation, and delivery management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare concise executive-level updates.
Strong stakeholder management, influencing, problem-solving, and decision-support capability.
Ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, deadlines, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
Ability to maintain project discipline in a non-automated environment.
Good understanding of business processes, finance operations, reporting cycles, audit, controls, risk, and compliance environments.
Competence in project management tools, Microsoft Office applications, collaboration platforms, and project reporting templates.
KEY ATTRIBUTES
Organised, disciplined, and detail oriented.
Practical, delivery-focused, and comfortable working at pace.
Confident engaging with senior stakeholders and resolving delivery challenges constructively.
Analytical and commercially aware, with sound judgement and a solutions-focused mindset.
Collaborative, resilient, adaptable, and able to work across diverse teams and functions.
SUCCESS MEASURES
Projects delivered within agreed scope, timelines, budget, quality, and governance expectations.
Risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions are actively managed and clearly reported.
Stakeholders understand project progress, required decisions, and delivery implications.
Project documentation is complete, current, and suitable for governance, audit, and handover purposes.
Business outcomes are embedded through effective transition, readiness, and post-implementation support.

Fuel consumption.

Quotations.

Expected volumes.

About the position
Attention Graduates! We have an opportunity for you to use your qualifications for good.
To get started with your application, click the link below to apply or visit ourCareers page on the website:
https://confluent.simplify.hr/vacancy/pucjgq
If you've just finished your qualification in any financial industry related field like Management, Finance, Business, or Accounting, for example - then keep reading, you'll want to hear this.
Confluent has permanent opportunities available for young talent like you. If you come with energy, confidence, and ambition the rest will come.
What is the rest you ask? Growth, exposure, support, and a chance to help real people every day.
Summary:
We are looking for intelligent and motivated graduates to join our Onboarding team as Financial Assessors, ultimately progressing into the Financial Consultant role within 6-12 months. As a Financial Assessor, you'll contact consumers who need financial assistance and have expressed their interest in our services. First, you will gather their information and then you'll provide them with an initial/light assessment of their financial position and educate them about the ways in which we can help them with our solutions.
You will need to be a quick-thinking and decisive individual who can manage client expectations and answer their questions in a timely and informative manner. As a Financial Assessor, you'll be the first point of contact in a client's debt management journey which makes you an important ambassador for the brand, and a significant part of our solution funnel. So, you'll have to come with energy, friendliness, and professionalism.
In addition, you'll be using our systems to connect with clients and transfer them to the next stage in our process (Financial Consultants) - so being tech savvy will be beneficial.
Financial Assessors are a key part of our consumers' journey. We'll provide extensive induction and role specific training to you, to ensure that you're fully prepared for the challenge.
What makes this role even better, is that there are many opportunities to grow. Should you find yourself being a top performer, there is great potential for you to join our Financial Consulting team, where you can make an even greater impact on the lives of consumers.
Responsibilities:
Contact clients who have made enquiries with the company to gather information about their financial situation.
Assessing client financial information to determine their financial position.
Conducting financial assessments - gathering, checking and interpreting a client's full financial picture so the next stage of the journey can be completed accurately.
Make outbound calls to potential clients.
Manage consumer engagements on our various platforms and/or Outbound Channels.
Working and following up on your WIP (work in progress) - owning your pipeline rather than waiting for it to be worked for you.
Provide excellent customer service and manage client expectations accordingly.
Meeting daily, weekly and monthly targets.
Job shadowing across both the Financial Assessor and Financial Consultant sides of the journey, so you understand where your client is going next.
Transfer eligible consumers to our expert Financial Consulting team to complete a thorough assessment.
Requirements:
Matric - compulsory.
Bachelor's degree / National Diploma in a financial industry related field.
Computer Literate - MS Office
Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
Willingness to work shifts.
Advantageous:
A Commerce degree.
An additional language - working proficiency in Afrikaans or another South African language.
Previous sales experience, particularly in a contact centre environment.
Experience in a customer service role.
Skills and competencies we are looking for:
Accuracy: You handle detailed information carefully and stay attentive to detail, even when the volume is high.
Adaptability: You adjust how you work with each individual rather than running the same script at everybody.
Analysing and forming opinions: You examine matters systematically and work through them in a structured way.
Client focus: You identify what a client actually needs and respond to it, rather than to what you assumed they needed.
Results oriented: You demonstrate commitment to agreements and follow through on what you said you would do.
Persuasiveness: You present your ideas and opinions with clear arguments, in order to reach an agreement.
Cooperation: You work with others to contribute to a shared objective.
Integrity: You comply with generally accepted standards in everything related to the role.
Performing under pressure: You maintain effective performance under pressure, and when faced with setbacks or disappointments.
Assertiveness: You stand up for yourself effectively and hold your position when it matters.
Benefits:
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Opportunity to work with a talented team of professionals.
Chance to make a real difference in the lives of our clients.
Opportunity to grow and develop your career.
Debt Counselling registration - we support and fund your DC registration, which is what opens the Financial Consultant route to you.
Access to bursaries to further your studies.
Short courses to advance your career within Confluent.
Medical & Retirement Annuity Benefits and more.
Half a day off for your birthday.
Company Transportation provided when applicable.
Who is Confluent?
As an award-winning industry leader in financial advice and solutions, Confluent is positioned to operate in a largely underserved market and will continue to grow. We have big plans for our future, and that could include you!
The people who thrive here genuinely care about making a difference, are self-motivated and driven, creative thinkers and collaborators, and are hungry to learn and grow.
Are you looking to use your newly earned qualification not only in the finance sector but also to add meaning and purpose to your career? If so, Confluent is the place to be.
The work we do and the way we do it makes a real, lasting difference to the lives of those we reach.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
SUPPORT the Cybersecurity strategy of a dynamic Internet Service & Network Specialist seeking your technical expertise as a Cybersecurity Engineer where you will deploy and maintain security solutions, investigate security events, manage vulnerabilities, and ensure compliance with security standards and regulatory requirements. You will further be responsible for the implementation, operation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of Cybersecurity technologies and controls that safeguard the organization's information assets. The role focuses on securing network, endpoint, cloud, and application environments through effective threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and security engineering practices. Working closely with IT and business stakeholders, you will help ensure that security is embedded into operational processes and technology initiatives while supporting the organization's resilience against cyber threats. The successful candidate must have Matric/Grade 12, a Degree/Diploma in IT with 3-5 years' relevant work experience including hands-on experience administering and securing Microsoft Windows Server environments. Your tech tools should include Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
DUTIES:
Security Engineering & Implementation -
Deploy, configure, and maintain security technologies across network, endpoint, cloud, and application environments.
Administer security tools such as Firewalls, IDS/IPS, EDR/XDR, SIEM, IAM, and DLP solutions.
Perform system hardening in line with security standards and best practices.
Ensure security controls remain operational, effective, and appropriately configured.
Security Monitoring & Threat Management -
Monitor security environments for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Analyse logs, alerts, and events using SIEM and other monitoring tools.
Vulnerability & Risk Management -
Conduct vulnerability scans and assessments.
Assist with penetration testing activities and remediation planning.
Track vulnerabilities through to closure.
Support patch management and system remediation efforts.
Incident Response & Recovery -
Participate in incident investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
Execute incident response procedures and playbooks.
Assist in root cause analysis and post-incident reviews.
Maintain incident documentation and evidence.
Compliance & Governance -
Support compliance initiatives relating to ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, POPIA, and other applicable frameworks.
Assist with audits and compliance assessments.
Maintain security documentation, standards, procedures, and records.
Monitor adherence to security policies and standards.
Stakeholder Engagement -
Work closely with IT Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Application teams.
Communicate technical findings and recommendations effectively.
Provide security guidance and awareness support to internal stakeholders.
Contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement initiatives.
REQUIREMENTS:
Qualifications –
Matric \ Grade 12 (Compulsory).
Degree or Diploma in Information Technology.
Experience/Skills –
3-5 Years' experience in IT Infrastructure, Systems Administration, or Cybersecurity.
Hands-on experience administering and securing Microsoft Windows Server environments.
Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD).
Experience with Microsoft 365 administration and security technologies.
Exposure to security monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management.
Experience implementing and supporting security solutions such as firewalls, EDR/XDR, SIEM, and IAM.
Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure and Cloud Security principles.
Experience with system hardening, patch management, and security best practices.
Exposure to security frameworks and compliance requirements such as ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, and POPIA.
Valid Driver’s License and willingness to travel to client sites or project locations as required.
Desired – Not Mandatory Certifications:
Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)
Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC 401)
MCSE: Core Infrastructure/ MCSA Windows Server 2016
Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate
Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate
Fortinet NSE4
CC Cybersecurity

Team Collaboration.
Communication & Reporting.
Adaptability & Continuous Learning.
Stakeholder Management.
Project Coordination.
Technical Documentation.
Risk-Based Decision Making.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
SUPPORT the active management, optimization and strategic oversight of the property portfolio within the Greater Gauteng region as the next Regional Finance Manager wanted by a growing dynamic Investment and Commercial Property Management Firm. The role is commercial, analytical and operational in nature, focusing on asset performance, strategic input, feasibility analysis, Capex motivation and value enhancement initiatives.
The role is not an accounting, bookkeeping, tax or payroll position.
Statutory reporting and transactional finance functions are performed at head office level. The Regional Finance Manager’s responsibility is to interpret financial and operational information, translate it into insights, and support informed asset-level decision-making.
DUTIES:
As Regional Finance Manager, the individual will be responsible for supporting asset-level performance, strategic
initiatives and commercial decision-making across the regional portfolio. This will include, but not be limited to, the
following areas:
Asset Performance & Portfolio Management -
Interpret asset-level financial and operational performance against approved budgets, forecasts and feasibilities.
Analyse variances, identify underperformance, risks and opportunities, and prepare clear commentary for the Regional Manager and team.
Review vacancies, lease expiries and income sustainability across the portfolio and provide guidance on how to improve these and reduce risks.
Identify income leakage, cost inefficiencies and value erosion risks at asset level.
Support corrective action planning in response to underperformance on a portfolio level.
Financial Analysis, Budgets & Variance Management –
Interpret management accounts, budgets and forecasts and translate financial data into commercial insights.
Assist with preparation of asset-level forecasts, cash flow projections and scenario modelling.
Analyse budget deviations and overspends and propose mitigation strategies.
Support the Regional Manager in managing and controlling overspend risks.
Prepare asset summaries and performance dashboards for internal reporting.
Capex Planning, Feasibilities & Exco Submissions -
Assist with regional Capex planning, prioritisation and tracking.
Prepare financial feasibilities and return analyses for refurbishments, upgrades, redevelopments and change-of-use initiatives.
Compile Capex motivations and supporting documentation for submission to Exco.
Track approved Capex projects against budgets, timelines and strategic objectives.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess performance against expected returns.
Strategic Asset Management & Decision Support -
Support buy / hold / sell analysis and asset-level strategic assessments.
Assist with preparation of investment memorandums and disposal recommendations.
Conduct market research relating to rentals, demand, competitors and regional trends.
Support longer-term asset strategy formulation and implementation.
Track execution of approved strategies and report on outcomes.
Leasing, Tenant & Income Optimization Support -
Work closely with Leasing and Property Management teams to support income optimization initiatives.
Provide commercial input into leasing deals, renewals, restructurings and incentive proposals.
Monitor tenant performance and credit risk from an asset value perspective.
Review tenant reconciliations, escalations and risks from a commercial standpoint.
Review monthly tenant billing, inclusive of fixed costs and recoveries.
Support renewal, restructuring or exit strategies where required.
Assist with preparing tender documentation and proposals.
Operational Oversight & Cross-Functional Coordination -
Liaise with Property Management, Facilities, Leasing and Finance teams to ensure alignment with asset strategies.
Monitor operational issues that may impact asset value, including maintenance, vacancies, tenant risk and cost pressures.
Operational oversight of Property Administrators on Debtors function, including providing guidance and support, monitoring reporting to ensure frequent and accurate updates, and performing any other reasonable duties as required in support of regional performance.
Operational oversight of Property Administrators on Creditors functions, including providing guidance and support, monitoring accounting allocations, accurate reviewing and signing off on payment packs for weekly payment runs, compiling weekly payment run lists and saving signed-off packs correctly, and performing any other reasonable duties as required in support of regional performance.
Assist with review of operating cost structures and efficiency initiatives (without performing accounting functions).
Escalate material risks, inefficiencies or value-impacting issues to the Regional Manager.
Support resolution of escalated operational matters.
General Business & Reporting -
Prepare asset-level reports, presentations and dashboards for senior management and Exco.
Provide regular reporting and commentary to the Regional Manager.
Support ad hoc analysis and reporting requests as required.
Comply with all internal processes, policies and governance requirements.
Manage and maintain Partner meeting reports and take minutes in meetings.
Manage and maintain Body Corporate reports and keep record of AGM Meetings and Minutes.
Prepare monthly credit card reconciliations for Head Office submission.
Prepare weekly fleet vehicle inspections, review and prepare monthly reports.
Manage and maintain ordering of stationery, groceries, consumables and stock control monthly.
Monitor and update Regional Office Asset Registers monthly for Head Office Submission.
Monitor and review Property Asset Registers monthly to ensure accurate recording of new/disposed assets.
Operational oversight of Property Managers, Property Administrators, and Receptionist/Office Administrator.
Perform any other reasonable duties as required in support of regional asset management objectives.
REQUIREMENTS:
Degree in Accounting, Property Studies, Real Estate, Finance, Economics, Commerce or a related field.
5–7 Years’ experience in an Asset Management, Property Analysis, Consulting or Property Finance role.
Exposure to retail, commercial, mixed-use and/or student portfolios advantageous.
Strong Excel and financial modelling and presentation skills.
Gauteng market knowledge will be beneficial.

Finance
Manager

Contribute to the development and improvement of the ERP Human Resources capabilities.
Contribute to the fostering of a continuous improvement culture to ensure ongoing enhancement and optimisation of platform capabilities and technical skills.

Minimum 7 - 10 years working experience in SAP HR and SuccessFactors.

About the position
ENVIRONMENT:
Our client operates a real-time communications platform offering call tracking, number privacy, click-to-call, SMS and WhatsApp solutions to clients across South Africa, the UK and Europe. When a call has to connect, it has to connect.  They are hiring one person to keep the platform healthy, including the infrastructure it runs on, its security posture and the customers who depend on it. This is a hands-on role offering real ownership from day one, working directly with a small, senior engineering team who will provide training on the technology stack.
You will own three key areas:
Platform & DevOps (~40%)
Deploy and monitor their production Docker Swarm fleet on AWS, including EC2, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache Redis, S3 and SES.
Keep the Celery queue environment healthy by identifying backlogs, stalled schedulers and memory-intensive workers before customers are affected.
Manage their ELK stack, including Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana and Metricbeat, as well as their alerting rules.
Triage Sentry errors, own the weekly systems-health review and keep runbooks up to date.
Support continuous integration through GitHub Actions, staging deployments and database maintenance.
Security (~25%)
Own the SentinelOne EDR console, including endpoint coverage, alert triage and escalation.
Run Greenbone vulnerability scans, act on the findings and ensure scan targets remain accurate.
Own GitHub security hygiene, including Dependabot alerts, dependency upgrades, secret scanning and branch protection.
Maintain fail2ban, AWS WAF and firewall rules across the voice and Session Border Controller (SBC) fleet.
Track penetration-testing findings through to closure.
Product & Customer Support (~35%)
Provide Tier 1–2 support for their Voice, SMS and WhatsApp products.
Investigate call-quality, routing and Call Detail Record (CDR) issues across FreeSWITCH, FusionPBX and their SBCs.
Investigate SMS delivery and Delivery Receipt (DLR) issues with SMPP suppliers.
Provision numbers (DIDs), configure routing and transfer numbers between accounts.
Log and drive supplier tickets while keeping customers and account managers informed.
What They Need from You:
At least two years of experience in a commercial DevOps, Systems Administration, Network Operations Centre (NOC), Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or technical-support engineering role. This is not an entry-level position.
Confidence working with Linux (Ubuntu), including shell, Systemd, journald, networking and SSH.
Practical Docker experience, with the ability to read a Compose file and troubleshoot a container that will not start.
Working knowledge of AWS, including EC2, RDS, S3, IAM and security groups.
Sufficient Python knowledge to read Django code, run a management command and fix a minor bug.
SQL skills sufficient to answer support-related questions using the database.
Confidence working with Git and GitHub.
Willingness to carry an on-call phone as part of a shared rota.
Strong written communication skills. A significant part of the role involves clearly explaining what happened and what was done to resolve it.
On-Call Responsibilities:
The platform carries live calls and messages and therefore requires support outside standard office hours. You will join a shared after-hours rota with the engineering team. You will never be the only person available, as every escalation path ends with a senior engineer. You will not join the rota until you can perform production deployments without supervision.
A standby allowance applies for every week that you carry the phone, and any night work is compensated with leave.
Bonus Points For:
Exposure to VoIP/SIP technologies such as FreeSWITCH, Asterisk or Kamailio, or experience with SMPP/SMS.
Experience with Elasticsearch, Kibana, Grafana or similar observability tools.
Experience with security tools and practices, including EDR, vulnerability scanners, WAF and CIS hardening.
Experience with Ansible, Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools.
A security certification such as Security+, eJPT or an Azure/AWS security certification, or a Linux certification such as RHCSA or LFCS.

The majority of your work will be product documentation: user guides, installation manuals, quick-start guides, and other materials that help customers and partners get the most out of technology. The remainder will be proposal and bid writing: developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and other procurement opportunities. This position requires excellent writing and communication skills, strong attention to detail, effective time management, and the ability to present complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. You will work closely with the Bids and Technical Writing Manager (based in Cape Town) while collaborating daily with Subject Matter Experts, Product Owners, and Engineering teams across the US and India offices.

Product Documentation -
Create and maintain product documentation for the Glance® SaaS platform and hardware and software solutions, including user guides, installation manuals, quick-start guides, cut sheets, and training materials.
Translate complex technical material into clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate content for a range of readers, from field technicians to city officials.

Identify documentation gaps and proactively develop content to address them.
Bid & Proposal Writing -
Support the development and submission of responses to RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and other procurement opportunities.
Draft technical content, executive summaries, methodologies, and supporting proposal documentation.
Incorporate information from subject matter experts, Engineers, and Product teams to produce compliant, accurate, and compelling responses.

Bid Response Library & Process Improvement -

Contribute to the development of our AI-assisted proposal tools by helping to organise and structure the knowledge base that underpins them.
Maintain proposal templates, content repositories, and version control processes across platforms such as Google Drive.
Collaboration & Communication -
Work closely with your manager and US-based colleagues across multiple time zones, with adjusted working hours to support regular collaboration.
Engage proactively with subject matter experts to source, validate, and update technical content.
Ensure consistency in tone, structure, branding, and terminology across all written materials.
Manage multiple priorities and competing deadlines.

A Degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Technical Communication, or a related field; alternatively, a technical degree (Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or similar) combined with strong professional writing experience. Professional writing roles where precision, structure, and clarity were essential. For example, science writing, medical writing, legal or policy writing, grant writing, journalism, or research communication could provide good fits.
Documentation or communications roles in technology, engineering, or public sector environments.
Academic or research roles involving substantial writing, editing, and information management.
We’re specifically looking for:
Excellent written English — clear, precise, and adaptable to different audiences and formats.
Strong research instincts: the ability to find information, ask the right questions, and know when you understand something well enough to write about it accurately.
Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and consistency.
Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
Intellectual curiosity and the confidence to learn new technical domains quickly.
Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office; comfort with document collaboration tools.

KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS:
Perform the total scope of work in the Division, including business development, applied research and technology development, technology transfer and commercialisation.
Provide strategic leadership in driving high impact RDI programmes, commercial projects, contract research and funding strategies to drive productivity and ensure the financial sustainability of the Division.

Minimum 10 years' experience in pyrometallurgy research and/or technology development.
Experience in designing and operating pilot and/or industrial scale electric arc furnaces.
Strong pyrometallurgical testwork planning and execution capabilities, with the ability to develop bespoke experimental techniques, models and prototypes from first principles up to pilot scale demonstration.
Track record in leading multidisciplinary teams in specialist research areas such as computational methods in engineering and process design, refractory materials design and characterisation, and technology and process demonstration.
Demonstrable ability to conceptualize and manage complex RDI projects and take ideas from concept to market.
Experience in designing pyrometallurgical processes and flowsheets using thermochemical software tools such as HSC Chemistry and FactSage.

A PhD in Metallurgical/Chemical/Process/Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, or equivalent, with a strong focus on pyrometallurgy research and/or technology development is a definite advantage.
Professional registration is an added advantage.
Experience with postgraduate supervision is an added advantage.
BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES:
Team player who enjoys variety and has a strong affinity for planning and executing new and high impact research.
Passion for research, technology development, and technology transfer.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Ability to work in a stressful and demanding environment
Willing to travel locally and internationally
Prepared to work shifts in hot and dusty plant environments when required
Ability to independently engage with industry leaders, operators and high-level international stakeholders
Excellent writing and presentation skills

This is a hands-on operational leadership role for someone who thrives on keeping warehouse operations running efficiently, maintaining exceptional inventory accuracy, developing high-performing teams and driving continuous improvement

Warehouse Operations
Manage and oversee all day-to-day warehouse activities with a strong operational focus
Ensure efficient receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing and dispatch processes
Optimise warehouse layout and space utilisation
Develop, implement and maintain warehouse SOPs
Monitor and improve productivity and operational efficiency
Ensure warehouse equipment is properly maintained and utilised
Maintain high standards of housekeeping and 5S
Manage inbound and outbound stock movements, including aged stock, stock destructions and third-party movements

Investigate errors, identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions
Maintain accurate operational records, reporting and documentation
Lead, supervise and support warehouse personnel
Maintain training records and ensure employees are competent in their roles
Address NCAs raised by customers and third parties and implement appropriate action plans
Conduct daily spot checks to ensure compliance with PPE requirements
Manage overtime effectively and control unnecessary labour costs
Inventory Management

Manage regular cycle counts and annual stock takes
Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies
Ensure accurate inventory transactions on WMS/ERP systems
Monitor stock movements and implement controls to minimise losses and damages
Manage slow-moving, obsolete and excess inventory
Team Leadership
Lead, manage and develop warehouse personnel
Set performance objectives and conduct regular performance reviews
Manage workforce planning, scheduling and resource allocation
Identify training and development opportunities
Build a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement
Health, Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with Occupational Health and Safety requirements
Maintain a safe, clean and well-organised warehouse
Conduct regular safety inspections and audits
Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions
Ensure adherence to relevant policies and regulatory requirements
Continuous Improvement
Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes and efficiency
Drive cost-reduction and productivity initiatives
Implement warehouse management and inventory-control best practices
Support operational excellence and continuous improvement programmes
What Success Looks Like
You'll be measured against key operational indicators including:
Inventory accuracy
Stock loss and shrinkage
Warehouse productivity
Picking accuracy
Order fulfilment accuracy
Space utilisation
Health and safety compliance
Labour productivity
Stock count accuracy
What You'll Bring

A Diploma or Degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Warehousing or a related field
A minimum of 5 years' experience in warehouse management
Experience managing warehouse teams in a fast-paced operational environment
Working knowledge of WMS and ERP systems
Strong knowledge of health and food safety protocols
Strong knowledge of cold storage processes
Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills
Strong administrative, reporting and analytical capabilities
Experience with budgeting and cost control
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
A proven track record in process improvement
Lean or Continuous Improvement certification will be advantageous, as will experience in FMCG, manufacturing, retail or distribution environments
The Ideal Candidate
You're a hands-on, operationally focused leader who knows how to balance people, processes, productivity and performance
You bring structure to complex warehouse operations, take ownership of challenges and are always looking for ways to improve efficiency, reduce costs and raise standards
If you're ready to lead a warehouse operation where accuracy, safety, productivity and continuous improvement matter, this could be the next opportunity for you

descriptions.description:
External Sales Representative (Westmead - KZN)
Sales Fraternity
R27,000 per month
Permanent Intermediate position
Westmead
Posted 19 Sep 2026 by Sales Fraternity
Expires in 14 days
Job 2644472
Save
Apply Now
About the position
About the Role
The External Sales Representative will be responsible for new business development and account management within truck body sales and repairs, managing the complete sales process from initial customer engagement through specification, quotation, order, delivery handover and ongoing aftersales support. This is a made-to-order fabricated product environment, meaning the role carries genuine technical responsibility. The representative must accurately scope each job according to the customer's chassis, payload and operating requirements and will be accountable for ensuring that what is sold can be manufactured safely, legally and within the agreed commercial parameters. The role requires a commercially driven salesperson who can generate their own business, develop strong relationships within the transport and logistics sector and confidently sell bespoke technical solutions.
Key Responsibilities
New Business Development & Sales
Generate and develop new business across the allocated territory.
Prospect for new customers rather than relying solely on inherited accounts or incoming enquiries.
Build and maintain relationships with fleet operators, transport businesses, logistics companies, dealer networks and other relevant customers.
Manage the complete sales process from first contact through specification, quotation, order and delivery handover.
Develop opportunities involving truck bodies, repairs and related fabricated solutions.
Manage longer sales cycles, fleet procurement processes and formal tenders, including vendor-registration requirements.
Prepare accurate quotations for bespoke work.
Maintain appropriate pricing and protect commercial margins rather than relying on discount-led selling.
Achieve agreed sales and revenue targets.
Technical Sales Responsibility
Understand customer operating requirements and accurately match the required body specification to the customer's chassis.
Demonstrate a working understanding of:
Gross Vehicle Mass (GVM).
Gross Combination Mass (GCM).
Axle loading.
Tare versus payload.
Wheelbase.
Cab-to-axle measurements.
Ensure proposed specifications remain within applicable legal and operational limits.
Use the provided technical programme to assist with vehicle and payload calculations.
Read and interpret technical drawings and body specifications sufficiently to accurately scope work for the workshop.
Identify where a customer requirement may not be technically feasible or buildable at the quoted price.
Recognise potential compliance issues relating to vehicle specifications and escalate them appropriately.
Maintain a working awareness of relevant road traffic legislation, applicable standards and roadworthiness requirements.
Understand considerations relating to dangerous-goods bodies, tail-lifts, load securing and dimensional limitations.
The ability to understand chassis specifications and payload calculations is the single most important technical requirement of this role.
Account Management & Aftersales
Maintain ownership of the customer relationship throughout the sales and delivery process.
Continue managing the relationship after delivery, including defects and warranty-related matters.
Ensure customer issues are followed through to resolution.
Build long-term relationships that encourage repeat fleet business.
Maintain regular communication and professional follow-up with customers.
Identify additional sales opportunities within existing accounts.
Commercial Responsibilities
Assess customer creditworthiness before committing to an order.
Support the business with customer collections where required.
Understand that commission is earned on customer payment received rather than invoice value alone.
Protect pricing and profitability on bespoke manufactured products, particularly where raw-material costs may fluctuate.
Ensure quoted specifications accurately reflect what can be manufactured and delivered.
Administration & Reporting
Maintain accurate records of customer activity and sales opportunities.
Use CRM systems consistently to record pipeline activity and customer interactions.
Prepare quotations and maintain disciplined written follow-up.
Use Excel and other relevant business systems as required.
Ensure sales opportunities and customer activities are formally recorded rather than managed informally.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Sales Experience
Minimum 4 years' external sales experience.
Experience within commercial vehicles, truck bodies, trailers or industrial capital equipment is strongly preferred.
Demonstrable track record of generating self-sourced new business.
Proven ability to identify, develop and close new opportunities.
Experience quoting customised or bespoke products and services.
Ability to maintain pricing and protect margins.
Experience managing longer sales cycles.
Experience with fleet procurement and formal tender processes.
Experience with vendor-registration processes.
Established relationships within the transport and logistics sector would be highly beneficial.
Technical Capability
Working understanding of chassis specifications and payload calculations.
Ability to understand GVM, GCM, axle loading, tare versus payload, wheelbase and cab-to-axle requirements.
Able to interpret technical drawings and body specifications.
Comfortable discussing technical requirements with customers and workshop teams.
Working understanding of relevant vehicle regulations, standards and roadworthiness requirements.
Able to identify specifications that could create technical, legal or compliance problems.
Practical & Administrative Requirements
Matric or equivalent.
Valid driver's licence with a clean driving record.
Own ability to travel regularly throughout the allocated territory.
Computer literate, including:
Quotation preparation.
Excel.
CRM systems.
Written customer follow-up.
Comfortable working within manufacturing workshops, customer yards and depots.
Willing and able to comply with all required PPE and workplace-safety requirements.
The position requires climbing on and off vehicles and working at height when measuring or inspecting fitted bodies. Candidates must therefore be capable of safely performing these inherent requirements of the role.
Advantageous
Existing relationships with:
Fleet operators.
Body builders.
Dealer networks.
Owner-driver markets.
Relevant technical qualification in mechanical engineering, fabrication, automotive or a related field.
Code 10 or Code 14 driver's licence.
Afrikaans in addition to English.
Candidate Screening Requirements
Candidates will be required to:
Confirm whether they are subject to any restraint of trade or non-solicitation agreement with a current or previous employer and provide relevant details where applicable.
Provide references from direct sales managers rather than peers.
Tools of Trade
The company provides:
Company vehicle.
Fuel card.
Laptop.
Internet connectivity.
Cellular phone.
These are provided as tools of trade.
All approved business travel, accommodation and related expenses are covered by the company through a company credit card. The representative will not be expected to personally fund business-related travel expenses.
***Salary - R27,000.00 per month CTC + Commission (Negotiable, based on skills, experience and in relation to current package)

This is a senior, hands-on sales leadership role for a commercially mature professional who can personally drive sales while motivating an indirect showroom network and developing a small internal sales team. The successful candidate will be responsible for strengthening partner performance, converting warm inbound opportunities, coaching sales teams and contributing directly to national revenue growth.

Sales Leadership & Revenue Growth
Take ownership of national sales performance and revenue growth.
Personally contribute to sales conversion and business development.

Monitor performance against targets and implement practical actions to improve results.

Influence and motivate partner teams who are not direct reports.

Engage prospective customers primarily through WhatsApp and telephone.

Clearly communicate product value, benefits and available finance options.
Handle objections confidently and close sales efficiently.
Follow up consistently with prospective customers to maximise conversion.
Internal Sales Team Management
Supervise, train and develop the internal sales resource.
Establish daily activity and conversion expectations.
Monitor individual performance against agreed KPIs.
Provide coaching and support where required.
Hold team members accountable for performance and follow-through.
Client Relationship Management
Develop strong relationships with new and existing customers.
Maintain professional communication throughout the sales process.
Identify additional sales opportunities within existing relationships.
Ensure customers receive a high standard of service.
Represent the business and its products professionally at all times.

The successful candidate should be:
An autonomous and proven sales leader who requires minimal supervision.
A strong hunter and closer with a demonstrable record of converting opportunities and growing revenue.
Comfortable selling both face-to-face and remotely via WhatsApp and telephone.
Experienced in converting warm leads rather than relying solely on cold calling.
Commercially sharp and results-driven.
Confident working within a premium, design-led consumer environment.

Proven sales leadership experience.
Strong personal sales and closing track record.
Experience managing a partner, dealer, franchise, showroom or other indirect sales network.
Experience coaching and developing salespeople.
Strong understanding of sales KPIs, conversion and performance management.
Experience managing digitally generated or inbound leads.
Strong relationship-management skills.
Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation ability.
Commercially minded with strong business judgement.
Ability to operate independently and take ownership of results.
Confidence dealing with premium retail, design or lifestyle customers and partners.

Must be based in Cape Town.
Valid driver's licence.
Own reliable vehicle.
Willing and able to travel nationally as required.
Comfortable conducting regular partner and showroom visits.
Able to travel periodically to Johannesburg and other provinces.

This opportunity offers genuine ownership of a growing premium-sales channel, access to qualified inbound demand and national commercial exposure. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to directly influence sales standards, partner performance, team capability and overall business growth. It is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys remaining close to the sale while also shaping and leading a broader commercial function.

The role works closely with the Company Secretary, Board, Board Committees and senior leadership to ensure that governance processes are accurate, timely and aligned with applicable legislation, regulatory expectations and recognised corporate governance standards.
Key responsibilities
Corporate governance
• Assist with the design, implementation and ongoing review of the corporate governance framework.
• Track legislative, regulatory and governance developments and help assess their impact on the organisation, its Board and management.
• Coordinate governance content and disclosures required for the annual report.
• Maintain Board and management committee charters, governance frameworks and policy registers, ensuring that documents are reviewed and approved within the required cycles.

• Manage the annual governance calendar and monitor Board, committee, shareholder and regulatory deliverables.

Board committee and shareholder administration
• Coordinate the full meeting cycle for the Board and its committees, including calendars, agendas, annual workplans, submissions, meeting packs and secure portal administration.
• Review Board and committee papers for completeness, quality and governance compliance, and follow up on late or outstanding submissions.
• Attend Board, Board Committee and relevant management committee meetings and prepare accurate minutes, resolutions and action schedules.
• Ensure approved minutes and resolutions are signed, securely retained and entered into the appropriate statutory or minute records.
• Arrange induction programmes for newly appointed directors and coordinate ongoing director development and mandatory governance training.

• Support director appointment processes, succession planning and related governance administration.
• Provide practical guidance to the Board and individual directors regarding their governance duties and responsibilities.
• Assist with the planning and administration of the Annual General Meeting and other shareholder meetings.
Statutory and regulatory compliance
• Coordinate statutory filings and submissions to CIPC, the FSCA and other relevant regulatory authorities.
• Maintain accurate statutory registers and records for directors, prescribed officers, shareholders and Board Committees.
• Prepare and submit annual returns and other statutory documentation within prescribed deadlines.
• Maintain a central compliance tracker for governance obligations, approvals, filings and renewals.
• Monitor governance requirements applicable to prescribed officers and other key persons.
Risk ethics and compliance support
• Assist the Board and relevant committees with oversight of ethics and compliance programmes.
• Provide governance support to risk management and assurance processes.
• Maintain conflict-of-interest, declaration and related governance registers.
• Support the Social, Ethics and Conduct Committee in meeting its statutory and governance responsibilities.

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Corporate Governance, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline.
• A Chartered Governance Professional qualification through CGISA or CGI, or active progress towards the qualification, will be advantageous.
• Five to eight years of relevant company secretarial or corporate governance experience.
• Previous experience supporting Boards and Board Committees in banking, financial services or a listed organisation.
• Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, Banks Act, Prudential Authority requirements, FSCA regulations and King IV principles.
• Demonstrated ability to draft clear, accurate Board and committee minutes and resolutions.

The ability to analyse customer information critically and document findings and recommendations clearly.

About the position
Our client is seeking an experienced Product Specialist to bridge the gap between legal practice, contract lifecycle management and enterprise technology. This is a specialist opportunity for a legal professional who understands commercial contracts and can translate legal requirements into structured workflows, product requirements and practical system functionality.
The successful candidate will work across the full contract lifecycle, from intake and matter creation through drafting, negotiation, approvals, e-signature, AI-assisted review, contract activation, obligations, renewals, amendments and reporting.
Key Responsibilities
Map and optimise end-to-end contract and legal workflows.
Translate legal and client requirements into structured fields, workflows, user stories and acceptance criteria.
Design and validate contract intake forms, matter creation and pre-signature workflows.
Test drafting, negotiation, approvals, Delegation of Authority and e-signature functionality.
Configure and validate post-signature contract records, metadata, lifecycle events and obligations.
Test AI-assisted contract review, summarisation, clause extraction, risk assessment and document comparison.
Develop and refine legal risk playbooks covering areas such as confidentiality, indemnity, liability, termination, insurance and dispute resolution.
Define and test contractual obligations, tasks, reminders, triggers and evidence requirements.
Validate dates, terms, renewals, notice periods and termination mechanics.
Support the linking and management of amendments, addenda and master agreements.
Analyse contract datasets and support migration, classification, reconciliation and data-quality initiatives.
Plan and execute expert UAT, regression testing and release validation.
Investigate defects and distinguish between product, configuration, AI, data and process issues.
Work closely with product owners, developers, implementation teams and clients to refine solutions.
Support client demonstrations, training, UAT sessions and adoption activities.
Contribute to reporting, dashboards and contract-management information requirements.
Requirements
LL.B or equivalent legal qualification.
Strong practical experience in commercial contracts, contract drafting, contract review, contract management or legal operations.
Experience within legal technology, Contract Lifecycle Management, matter management, product specialisation or enterprise software.
Proven ability to translate legal concepts into structured data, workflows and testable requirements.
Hands-on UAT and software-testing experience, including defect investigation and validation.
Strong understanding of contract metadata, structured fields and document-based testing.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to engage confidently with legal professionals, clients, product teams and technical stakeholders.
Advantageous
Admission as an Attorney with post-qualification commercial/legal experience.
Experience with AI-assisted contract review, NLP, clause extraction or legal AI.
Experience configuring risks, obligations, tasks, events, metadata and contract types within a CLM platform.
Knowledge of e-signature, document collaboration, approvals/DoA and matter management.
Experience with Agile product delivery, user stories and release planning.
Contract migration, classification, deduplication or amendment-linking experience.
Experience presenting legal technology solutions to clients.
Exposure to FICA/KYC, POPIA or legal compliance workflows.

Reporting to the Head of Procurement, you will play a key role in the procurement and coordination of chilled, frozen food, and/or meat products, ensuring consistent product availability and seamless order execution. Working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will help maintain strong supplier relationships, support efficient procurement processes, and contribute to the smooth day-to-day operation of the supply chain.
1. Sourcing and Procurement:
Identify and evaluate potential suppliers, both domestic and international in line with approved category strategy.
Request quotations, compare offers and recommend preferred suppliers for approval.
Negotiate pricing and terms within defined parameters, escalating high-value negotiations where required.
Continuously monitor market trends and conditions to make informed purchasing decisions.

Ensure that all purchased products comply with relevant food safety and labelling regulations.

Stay informed about industry trends, consumer preferences, and emerging products in the industry.
Make recommendations for introducing new products based on market demands and consumer preferences.

Build professional working relationships with suppliers focused on reliability and service.
Monitor performance and capture feedback for review with manager.
7. Reporting:
Prepare and present reports on procurement, order-tracking, market trends, and supplier performance to management.

Maintain accurate inventory and product records across all internal systems.

Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., supply chain management, business, or agriculture).

Strong negotiation, communication and coordination skills.
Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
