Introduction:
We are seeking an experienced Intermediate Data Engineer to join a company based in Pretoria and manage and develop an established Microsoft Fabric data platform. The successful candidate will ensure reliable day-to-day operations while delivering new data engineering requirements. This is a hands-on role requiring strong technical capability, independent problem-solving and the ability to work across data ingestion, transformation, modelling, warehousing and business intelligence integration.
Job Purpose:
To take ownership of an established Microsoft Fabric data platform, ensuring reliable operations and delivery of new data engineering requirements.

Duties & Responsibilities

REQUIREMENTS
Minimum education (essential):
Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field.
Minimum Education (desirable)
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering or a related field.
Relevant Microsoft Fabric and/or Azure data certification.
Minimum applicable experience (years):
4+ years of practical data engineering experience, including strong recent hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric.
Required nature of experience:
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, including OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines/Data Factory, notebooks and Dataflows Gen2.
Strong SQL Server and T-SQL capability, including complex query development, schema design, indexing and performance optimisation.
Practical experience developing, maintaining and supporting production ETL/ELT pipelines.
Experience integrating and extracting data from REST/SOAP APIs, databases, flat files and other structured or unstructured data sources.
Proficiency in data transformation using SQL and Python/PySpark, with an understanding of scalable data processing practices.
Practical experience in data warehousing, dimensional modelling, incremental loading, orchestration and schema evolution.
Experience with troubleshooting pipeline failures, data quality issues and performance bottlenecks, including the ability to restore service efficiently.
Experience with source control, CI/CD and deployment practices using Git, Azure DevOps or equivalent tools.
Experience supporting Power BI and other downstream analytical or reporting requirements.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of an existing technical environment with limited hand-holding.
Strong documentation, communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
Skills and Knowledge (essential):
Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Pipelines/Data Factory, notebooks and Dataflows Gen2.
SQL Server / T-SQL
Python / PySpark
REST/SOAP APIs and structured/unstructured data ingestion.
ETL/ELT, incremental loading, orchestration and scheduling.
Dimensional modelling, medallion architecture, schema evolution and data warehousing.
Power BI integration and understanding of downstream analytical requirements.
Git / Azure DevOps, CI/CD and environment deployment practices.
Monitoring, data quality, performance optimisation, security and operational support.
Other:
Proficient in Afrikaans and English.
Own transport and valid driver’s license.
KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS AND OBJECTIVES
Fabric Data Engineering and Pipeline Development
Take ownership of the existing Microsoft Fabric data engineering environment and become productive quickly following handover.
Design, develop, maintain and orchestrate reliable batch and near-real-time data ingestion pipelines using appropriate Microsoft Fabric capabilities.
Extract and ingest data from structured and unstructured sources, including REST APIs, SOAP APIs, databases and flat files.
Develop robust data transformation logic using SQL, Python/PySpark, Fabric notebooks and Dataflows Gen2, as appropriate.
Implement incremental loading, retry mechanisms, logging, monitoring and alerting to support data integrity and pipeline reliability.
Troubleshoot and resolve pipeline failures and data processing issues efficiently.
Optimise data pipelines and processing workloads for performance, scalability and cost-effectiveness.
Data Architecture and Platform Management
Design, manage and evolve scalable data architectures using Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse and SQL Server.
Maintain appropriate data-layering and medallion architecture principles, where applicable, with clear movement from raw to curated data.
Develop and maintain robust schema designs, indexes, partitioning and query strategies to support analytical and operational workloads.
Manage schema evolution and version control to maintain consistency and minimise disruption to downstream consumers.
Maintain metadata, data dictionaries, architecture documentation and technical documentation to improve supportability and reduce key-person dependency.
Define and maintain appropriate role-based access and security controls.
Data Warehousing and BI Integration
Build and maintain analytical data stores using Microsoft Fabric Warehouse and/or Lakehouse patterns.
Apply appropriate data-loading, partitioning, storage optimisation and query-performance practices.
Develop and maintain stable, well-modelled datasets for Power BI and other analytical consumers.
Work with reporting and analytical teams to investigate and resolve data-related issues.
Ensure data structures and outputs support downstream reporting and business intelligence requirements.
Data Modelling and Standards
Develop and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models.
Apply dimensional modelling techniques, including star and snowflake schemas, to support analytics and reporting.
Apply appropriate normalisation and relational modelling techniques for operational and analytical workloads.
Ensure consistency of data models across systems.
Manage schema versioning and evolution without unnecessarily disrupting downstream consumers.
Apply agreed data engineering standards and modelling principles consistently.
Ownership, Reporting and Communication
Work independently and take end-to-end ownership of assigned data engineering deliverables, incidents and production issues.
Provide clear and timely updates regarding progress, risks, dependencies and blockers.
Engage directly with technical and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and agree practical solutions.
Explain technical concepts and trade-offs in a manner appropriate to the relevant stakeholder.
Maintain practical technical documentation, including runbooks, architecture notes, change logs and release notes.
Take accountability for the successful delivery and operational support of assigned solutions.
Automation, Monitoring and Optimisation
Automate recurring data engineering and operational activities where practical.
Implement monitoring and alerting to identify data quality issues, pipeline failures and abnormal processing behaviour.
Analyse and optimise query, notebook and pipeline performance across SQL Server and Microsoft Fabric.
Monitor capacity and resource utilisation and contribute to scalability and cost-control decisions.
Deploy solutions using appropriate CI/CD and controlled deployment practices.
Security and Best Practices
Apply data security best practices, including secure authentication, least-privilege access and appropriate encryption.
Ensure data engineering solutions comply with applicable data governance policies and regulatory requirements.
Apply sound engineering practices relating to recoverability, auditability, supportability and controlled change.
Protect confidential and sensitive business information.
Contribution to the Team
Collaborate with developers, data analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical solutions.
Support effective handover and knowledge transfer to reduce key-person dependency within the data environment.
Share technical knowledge and contribute to continuous improvement of team practices and the data environment.
Provide guidance and support to junior team members where required.
Remain accountable for the quality, reliability and timeliness of own deliverables.
Quality Management and Compliance
Document data processes, transformations, dependencies and architectural decisions.
Validate data outputs through reconciliation, data quality checks and appropriate testing before production deployment.
Maintain high standards of engineering quality by following agreed development, code review, testing, deployment, backup and archival practices.
Ensure changes are appropriately tested, documented and controlled before implementation.
Safeguard confidential information and data.
Support compliance with applicable organisational policies, standards and regulatory requirements.

Market related

descriptions.title: Data & AI Engineer (JHB Hybrid)
descriptions.description:
DataFin was established in 1999. We pride ourselves on the fact that we have established relationships with industry leaders and a vast majority of our business is repeat business.

Duties & Responsibilities

ENVIRONMENT:
A provider of tailored Financial Solutions seeks a Data & AI Engineer to build, maintain, and improve reliable pipelines and curated datasets that feed the company’s analytics, reporting, and AI workloads, and you will help run the governed in-house AI platform that sits on top of them. This is one combined role, not a Data Engineer with an AI paragraph bolted on. Data flows from SQL Server and Azure SQL sources into Fabric, through bronze, silver, and gold layers, and out to the semantic, reporting, and AI consumption layers the business depends on. Expect the work to sit at roughly two-thirds Data Engineering and one-third applied AI in the first year, shifting further towards AI as adoption grows. Both halves run inside the same established standards, which cover metadata-driven, incremental, idempotent ELT, source control, gated deployment, and human review of anything AI-generated. You will grow into full ownership of production data and AI assets end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
DUTIES:
Data Engineering: Governed pipelines and the estate -
Develop and maintain batch and incremental ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver trusted datasets across our SQL Server / Azure SQL / Microsoft Fabric estate.
Write and optimise T-SQL transformation logic, stored procedures, views, and reconciliation queries, following our standards (CTEs over subqueries, idempotent and metadata-driven patterns).
Build and maintain Fabric pipelines, Dataflow Gen2 flows, and Lakehouse / Warehouse data assets.
Support data modelling: dimensional models, medallion (bronze / silver / gold) layer design, partitioning, and performance optimisation for analytics workloads.
Operate the estate: orchestration, scheduling, monitoring, logging, alerting, and methodical incident resolution for data jobs and platform processes.
Implement data validation, reconciliation, row-count and parity checks so reporting outputs can be trusted and prove it with evidence.
Applied AI: The governed AI platform -
Build and maintain the curated, documented datasets, retrieval indexes, and interfaces that governed AI platform and AI-assisted use cases consume.
Help run the in-house AI platform: content ingestion, indexing, configuration, access control, and routine health checks.
Develop Python automation for AI workloads, covering data preparation, embedding and indexing jobs, evaluation harnesses, and approved API integrations.
Build and evaluate AI use cases such as search, summarisation, classification, extraction, and workflow automation, measuring each against defined success criteria with human-review checkpoints built in.
Enforce data minimisation and anonymisation on every AI path: no personal information, credentials, or production data into unapproved tools, and no uncontrolled egress of data.
Record AI evaluation evidence, including what was tested, what the model produced, what a human reviewer changed, and why, so that AI-assisted output stays traceable and auditable.
Shared: Governance, delivery, and documentation -
Work the governed delivery flow: Git / Azure DevOps source control, feature branches, peer-reviewed pull requests, and gated environment promotion (Dev → UAT → production).
Produce and maintain documentation: pipeline design notes, source-to-target mappings, runbooks, AI use-case and configuration notes, and support procedures.
Collaborate with Analysts, the Head of Data & AI, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into governed, supportable data assets, without business logic drifting into unmanaged reports.
What you’ll work with –
Azure SQL and on-premises SQL Server, which form the core transactional and reporting estate.
The wider Fabric surface, including mirroring and CDC ingestion, deployment pipelines, and capacity management.
Python for transformation, automation, and tooling; DAX exposure on the BI side.
Azure DevOps for repos, boards, CI/CD pipelines, and gated deployments.
Power BI and SSRS as the consumption layer you feed.
The governed in-house AI platform, which covers agent tooling, retrieval and indexing, and the controls that make it safe to use on sensitive data. You will help run it, not just use it.
AI-assisted engineering under policy, meaning sanitised inputs, human review of generated code, and traceable output. It is how the whole team works, and how you will work too.
Evaluation and human-review workflows, which are how we decide whether an AI output is good enough to use and how that decision is evidenced.
REQUIREMENTS:
Minimum 1-year hands-on experience in Data Engineering, ETL / ELT, analytics engineering, database development, applied AI, or a closely related production-oriented role.
Solid SQL Server and T-SQL. You should be confident with joins, aggregations, CTEs, and multi-step transformation logic, and able to debug and reason about query performance.
Demonstrable Microsoft Fabric experience. You have built, supported, or substantially prototyped at least one of the following: a Fabric pipeline, a Lakehouse or Warehouse solution, a Dataflow Gen2 flow, or a Fabric notebook. Work, internship, or serious project evidence all count.
Understanding of data warehousing and pipeline design concepts (staging, incremental loads, dimensional modelling).
Working Python. You can read, write, and modify scripts for data preparation, automation, and integration, because the AI half of the role runs on it.
Practical, sceptical familiarity with modern AI tooling. You have used LLM or AI-assisted tools on real work and can explain where they got things wrong, not just that they were useful. No formal Machine-Learning or Data-Science background is required.
Familiarity with source control (Git or similar) and structured, reviewed ways of releasing changes.
Genuine care for data quality, security, least privilege, and confidentiality, including the discipline never to put sensitive data into an unapproved tool.
Advantageous –
Python or PySpark depth for data transformation at scale.
Dataflow Gen2, mirroring / CDC, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
Power BI semantic model and DirectLake awareness; SSRS report development.
Experience with APIs, file feeds, or enterprise source systems.
Retrieval-augmented generation, vector or semantic search, and embedding concepts.
Azure AI services, prompt and evaluation frameworks, agent tooling, or MLOps exposure.
DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer Associate) or another relevant Microsoft certification. These are valued rather than required and are achievable after appointment.
Relevant qualification (Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related) or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in a regulated financial-services or similarly controlled environment.
ATTRIBUTES:
You want to learn, so you ask good questions, absorb feedback, and close the loop.
You verify before you trust, and that includes AI output above all.
You take ownership end-to-end: build it, document it, support it.
You have a quality mindset, so you check your work and raise issues early rather than hoping.
You are comfortable with sensitive data and disciplined governance; process is a feature to you, not friction.
You keep composure in a delivery-focused environment and communicate honestly about progress and blockers.
Integrity and values, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
Attention to detail and a results-driven quality mindset.
Strong problem-solving; composure in a fast-moving, dynamic environment.
Works well in a team and independently; communicates openly.
Growth mindset, actively wanting to learn and develop

Desired Experience & Qualification

Data, AI, Engineer, JHB, Hybrid,

An industry leading Bank has an exciting opportunity available for a

data processing

A reputable software development company based in Pretoria is looking for Data Scientists with a strong focus on Decision Science and Commercial Analytics. The successful candidates will work on complex analytical problems, taking insights from data through to practical, measurable business decisions.
This is a hands-on Data Science role involving predictive modelling, forecasting, model validation, calibration, commercial analytics and benefit attribution. Candidates will be considered at Intermediate, Advanced and Senior levels, with responsibilities and autonomy aligned to experience.

Duties & Responsibilities

Analyse, transform and integrate data from multiple sources for analytical and modelling purposes.
Develop, enhance and evaluate predictive, forecasting, segmentation and propensity models.
Work with existing data science models, analytical pipelines and data processes, improving them where required.
Perform model validation, back-testing, calibration and performance monitoring.
Analyse variances between predicted and actual outcomes and identify underlying drivers.
Recalibrate models based on observed results to improve forecasting and decision-making.
Apply commercial analytics and decision science techniques, including ROI, NPV, payback, scenario and benefit analysis.
Support optimisation and prescriptive analytics, including sensitivity analysis and constrained allocation.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, defensible business recommendations.
Communicate assumptions, limitations, risks and trade-offs to technical and senior business stakeholders.

For Senior-level candidates, provide technical guidance, mentorship and analytical leadership across workstreams.

Approximately 2–4 years' hands-on Data Science experience for Intermediate, 4–7 years for Advanced and 7+ years for Senior-level positions.
Strong practical Python and SQL skills.
Experience with Spark, PySpark or comparable large-scale data processing environments.
Strong experience in data ingestion, profiling, cleansing, transformation and feature engineering.
Proven experience developing and validating statistical and predictive models.
Experience with forecasting, segmentation and propensity modelling.
Strong understanding of model validation, back-testing, calibration and performance monitoring.
Experience working with and enhancing existing analytical pipelines.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate technical findings into business decisions.
Decision Science, commercial analytics or investment analytics experience will be highly advantageous.
Experience with financial modelling, NPV, ROI, payback, causal inference, counterfactual analysis or benefit attribution is advantageous.
Exposure to optimisation and prescriptive analytics is advantageous.
MLOps and production model lifecycle experience, including tools such as MLflow or Databricks, will be advantageous.
A relevant degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Strong communication, documentation and stakeholder engagement skills.
Telecommunications experience is advantageous, although candidates from financial services, banking, insurance, retail, utilities, investment, infrastructure and other data-intensive environments will also be considered.

descriptions.title: Lead Data Scientist - Remote
descriptions.description:
Reference: PE011736-Tabz-1
Data science is not a support function at the company — it is central to the product. The company privacy-preserving models, entity-resolution algorithms, data-linkage methods, analytics, and AI-augmented pipelines are core to the value the company delivers to clients.
The Lead Data Scientist serves as second-in-command to the Head of Data Science and combines senior technical leadership with hands-on delivery. The role requires someone who can lead complex analytical work, represent the Data Science function when required, and remain actively involved in designing, coding, validating, and delivering solutions.
You will also play a key role in company transition from analytics built primarily through traditional SQL, Synapse Pipelines, and Power BI toward Python-powered Jupyter workflows that use Claude Code and other LLM tools to accelerate research, coding, documentation, prototyping, and production delivery.
The environment includes PySpark, Delta Lake, Jupyter Notebooks, Azure Synapse, Trino, Power BI, Kubernetes-hosted model serving, and Fast API inference endpoints.

Duties & Responsibilities

Engagement and location:
Location: South Africa (Remote) Permanent
Occasional travel (a few times/year – in person meeting/s) to Johannesburg or Cape Town required; proximity to either city preferred.
Reports to: Head of Data Science.
May lead an Agile delivery squad within the Platform organization.
Key responsibilities:
Own the analytical roadmap
. Help shape and prioritise the roadmap and backlog so analytical work is clearly defined, developed to a high standard, and delivered on time. Maintain a coherent customer analytics journey while identifying opportunities to create reusable assets.
Own customer analytical delivery end to end
. Translate ambiguous business questions into decision-ready analysis by framing the problem, defining success criteria, conducting the analysis, and presenting findings to senior stakeholders. Be prepared to explain clearly when the evidence does not support the customer's expected conclusion.
Write production-grade Python
. Develop maintainable, testable code using modern software-engineering practices and toolchains.
Apply warehouse and Lakehouse best practices
. Reason confidently about data grain, joins, provenance, effective dating, reconciliation, and traceability so published results can be linked back to source data and analytical conclusions reflect the quality and precision of that data.
Use AI throughout the delivery lifecycle
. Apply Claude Code and agentic workflows to research, prototyping, development, testing, documentation, and production delivery.
Generate insight across multiple data parties
. Work with matched, indirect, aggregated, or otherwise imperfect datasets using techniques such as weighted binning, dependency and importance measures, and validation controls. Understand the limitations of the data and recognise invalid or misleading comparisons.
Support Data Science leadership
. Act as deputy to the Head of Data Science when required, mentor team members, support delivery management, and represent the function with internal and external stakeholders.
Must-have technical skills / experience:
Senior-level data science expertise across machine learning, statistical modelling, and AI system design in production environments, including deploying, monitoring, and retraining models.
Advanced Python skills and strong experience with Jupyter Notebooks, pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn.
Experience with Delta Lake or comparable Lakehouse architectures, including PySpark, feature stores, training-data versioning, and schema evolution.
Strong data warehouse expertise, including Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, T-SQL, and/or ANSI SQL.
Strong analytics and visualisation experience using Power BI and Python-based visualisation or interactive-analysis tools.
Team-level technical or engineering leadership experience, including mentoring data scientists, owning delivery, and communicating with senior stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Minimum experience
:
7+ years of experience across data science, data analytics, or data warehousing, with substantial recent data science experience.
2+ years in a technical or engineering leadership role.
Bachelor's degree in a STEM discipline or equivalent professional experience.
Desirable experience:
Apache Ranger or Comparable data-governance technologies
Fast API
Automated testing with PyTest
PySpark and distributed data processing.
Kubernetes-based model deployment or serving.
C#.NET development
Angular or Electron development
Why you’ll love working for the company
:
The company believe in taking care of their team and creating an environment where you can thrive. As part of their company, you’ll enjoy:
Flexible working arrangements
: Whether you’re a night owl or an early bird, they offer hybrid and remote options to suit your lifestyle
Comprehensive benefits
: From a wellness program to home office reimbursements and continuous learning opportunities, they have got you covered.
Team culture
: Fun team-building activities, regular socials, and a supportive, inclusive culture that values transparency, accountability, and work-life balance.
Performance incentives
: Competitive salaries, ESOP, and recognition for your hard work.

Package & Remuneration

Annually

descriptions.description:
Duties & Responsibilities

Data Architect / Data Migration Specialist
Telecommunications
Roodepoort
Fixed-Term Contract (3 Years)
Reporting to: Programme Manager / Head of Data Architecture
Role Overview
Our client, a leading player in the South African Telecommunications industry, is seeking a highly skilled Data Architect / Data Migration Specialist to join a major transformation programme. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end architecture, modelling, and physical migration of critical inventory data. This role requires a deep understanding of telecom network inventory (Active and Passive), master data management principles, and the ability to reconcile complex legacy datasets into a modern target environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Data Architecture & Modelling:
Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models specifically for telecommunications inventory (e.g., OSS/BSS, Network Elements, Fibre, Towers, Spectrum, and IP addressing).
Define data architecture standards and patterns to support the migration of legacy inventory systems to the new target platform.
Collaborate with enterprise architects to ensure alignment with the overall IT strategy and roadmap.
Data Migration Strategy & Execution
Develop and execute a comprehensive data migration strategy, including data extraction, transformation, load (ETL), and validation processes.
Lead the profiling and analysis of legacy source systems to identify data quality issues, gaps, and structural inconsistencies.
Map source-to-target data transformations, ensuring all business rules and logic are documented and applied correctly.
Manage the cutover process, including dry runs, data load rehearsals, and final go-live execution.
Master Data Management (MDM) & Reconciliation
Implement MDM principles to ensure a "single source of truth" for inventory data across the organization.
Design and execute robust reconciliation frameworks to compare source and target datasets, identifying and resolving variances prior to migration sign-off.
Establish data governance protocols to maintain data integrity post-migration.
Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Leadership
Act as the primary subject matter expert (SME) for inventory data, providing guidance to developers, analysts, and business stakeholders.
Work closely with network engineers, field operations, and IT teams to understand data requirements and consumption patterns.
Produce high-quality technical documentation, including migration plans, mapping documents, and reconciliation reports.
Key Requirements (Qualification & Experience)
Essential
:
Experience: Minimum of 7+ years in Data Architecture or Data Engineering, with at least 3 years specializing in Data Migration within the Telecommunications sector.
Telecom Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of telecom inventory domains (e.g., Network Inventory, Logical & Physical Inventory, GIS/Fibre mapping, Service Inventory).
Technical Skills:
Proficiency in data modelling tools (e.g., Erwin, Visio, PowerDesigner).
Strong SQL skills and experience with ETL tools (e.g., Informatica, Talend, SSIS, or cloud-native equivalents).
Experience with database technologies (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
MDM Expertise: Proven experience implementing Master Data Management solutions and reconciliation techniques.
Contract Commitment: Must be available for the full duration of the 3-year contract.
Desirable:
Experience with specific telecom OSS/BSS platforms (e.g., Amdocs, Netcracker, Ericsson, Huawei).
Knowledge of South African telecommunications regulatory data requirements.
Certification in Data Management (DAMA/CDMP) or Cloud Architecture.
Key Competencies
Analytical Thinking: Ability to dissect complex data structures and solve logical problems.
Attention to Detail: Critical for reconciliation and data accuracy in a high-stakes migration.
Communication: Ability to translate technical data concepts for non-technical business stakeholders.
Resilience: Capable of working under pressure in a fast-paced programme environment.

jio@aridconsulting.co.za

descriptions.title: BI Developer
descriptions.description:
Introduction

Amazing chance to join a Software Development company that develops software for the insurance industry. They are a medium size company that look after their staff and give recognition. They have been around for over 25 years and have an international footprint in London. They have a branch in London, Stellenbosch and Rosebank. They are extremely people orientated and offer a fun dynamic working environment.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Power BI Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the reporting and analytics solutions that turn platform data into insight for our clients, covering both new client implementations and the ongoing maintenance and enhancement of reporting for existing clients.
The role spans client-facing insurance reporting built on the platform (policy, premium, claims, and book-of-business analytics for insurers, MGAs, and brokers) as well as internal management information that supports decision-making across the company.
Reporting is delivered directly against the operational data model rather than a data warehouse. Dashboards are sourced from a dedicated non-production SQL Server reporting instance, where T-SQL stored procedures, views, and functions form a curated reporting layer that shapes, joins, and aggregates the data before it reaches Power BI. Strong T-SQL is therefore as important as strong Power BI in this role. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable writing and tuning set-based queries at the database and building the semantic models, DAX measures, and visualisations that sit on top of them.
Because dashboards are consumed by external clients as well as internal teams, controlling what each user can see is a core design responsibility rather than an afterthought. The Power BI Developer owns the access model behind every report: how users are authenticated, how client and tenant data is isolated, how row-level and object-level security are applied within the semantic model, and how workspace and app permissions govern distribution. Note that the gateway connects to the source SQL Server using a single least-privilege service account, so per-user entitlement cannot be enforced by database permissions and must be designed and proven within the semantic model.
Working closely with development, implementation, and business stakeholders, the Power BI Developer builds robust semantic models, well-crafted DAX measures, and performant, intuitive dashboards, ensuring that every report is accurate, secure, and trusted as a single source of truth.
KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
1. Report & Dashboard Development
Design, develop, and maintain interactive Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models for both client-facing insurance reporting and internal management information. Translate business and client requirements into clear, intuitive visualisations that make complex insurance data easy to understand and act on.
2. SQL Development & the Reporting Data Layer
Write, optimise, and maintain the T-SQL stored procedures, views, and functions that supply the dashboards from the non-production SQL Server reporting instance. Push joins, aggregation, and business logic down to the database so that Power BI consumes clean, report-ready result sets, and maintain this reporting layer as a stable contract that insulates dashboards from change in the underlying platform schema.
3. Semantic Modelling & DAX Development
Build and maintain robust, reusable semantic models, shaping normalised operational data into report-friendly star schemas. Develop accurate, well-structured DAX measures to support analysis of policy, premium, claims, and operational data, and select the appropriate storage mode (Import, DirectQuery, or composite) for each requirement.
4. Data Access, Security & Authentication
Design, implement, and test the access model that determines what each user can see. This covers authentication and identity through Microsoft Entra ID or, where reports are embedded in the   platform, service principal authentication with embed tokens and an asserted effective identity. It also covers dynamic row-level security driven by an entitlement model that reflects insurance access hierarchies such as broker, agency, branch, class of business, and delegated authority; object-level security to conceal sensitive tables and columns such as commission terms or claimant personal data; and least-privilege credentials for the gateway service account. Access control must be demonstrably tested before every release, not assumed.
5. Refresh, Deployment & Power BI Service Administration
Manage workspaces, on-premises data gateways, scheduled and incremental refresh, and the promotion of content across development, test, and production environments. Apply the correct workspace and app roles for internal and client audiences, recognising that elevated workspace roles bypass row-level security. Schedule refresh windows to respect the load profile of the source SQL Server, monitor refresh reliability, and resolve failures promptly.
6. Data Quality & Governance
Ensure the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of all reporting outputs. Apply data minimisation so that personal and sensitive data is only brought into a model where it is genuinely required for reporting, support sensitivity labelling and data residency requirements across UK and South African client bases, and support compliance with POPIA, GDPR, and   data governance standards.
7. Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Analysis
Work closely with clients, implementation teams, and internal stakeholders to gather, analyse, and refine reporting requirements, including who is entitled to see what. Provide estimates, communicate progress clearly, and support users in adopting and getting value from reporting solutions.
8. Performance Optimisation, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Monitor and optimise query, refresh, and report performance, from execution plans at the database through to visual render times in the report. Maintain clear documentation of the SQL reporting layer, semantic models, measures, and the access and entitlement model, follow and enhance BI standards and best practice, and stay current with the evolving Power BI and Microsoft Fabric ecosystem.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Bachelor’s degree or National Diploma in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
3 to 5 years’ experience in a BI development or data-centric role, with strong hands-on Power BI experience across Desktop and the Power BI Service.
Strong T-SQL development skills on Microsoft SQL Server, including writing and maintaining stored procedures, views, functions, and complex set-based queries against normalised transactional schemas.
Practical query tuning ability: reading execution plans, understanding indexing and query cost, and writing reporting queries that perform well without adversely affecting the source system.
Proven ability to shape normalised operational data into report-friendly models, applying star schema and dimensional modelling concepts within the Power BI semantic model.
Strong proficiency in DAX for measures and calculations, including filter context, time intelligence, correct handling of ratios, and security expressions, together with working knowledge of Power Query (M).
Practical understanding of Power BI storage modes (Import, DirectQuery, and composite models) and their implications, including the constraints that apply when a model is sourced from stored procedures.
Hands-on experience implementing row-level security, including dynamic RLS driven by an entitlement or bridge table and the use of functions such as USERPRINCIPALNAME and CUSTOMDATA, and the ability to test it credibly.
A working understanding of Power BI access and sharing mechanics: Microsoft Entra ID identity, workspace and app roles, and which roles enforce or bypass row-level security.
Sound security instincts around credentials and data access: least-privilege service accounts, secure storage of gateway and data source credentials, and awareness of what an export or a shared link can expose.
Experience administering the Power BI Service: workspaces, on-premises data gateways, scheduled refresh, row-level security, and deployment pipelines or an equivalent controlled promotion process.
The following are strongly preferred and will carry material weight in selection:
Experience delivering reporting within the insurance industry, whether at an insurer, MGA, broker, or insurance software vendor.
A working understanding of insurance data and terminology: the policy lifecycle (quote, bind, endorsement or mid-term adjustment, renewal, cancellation), premium, claims, commission, and reinsurance, together with the measures built from them such as gross written premium, earned premium, loss ratio, claims frequency and severity, retention, and new business conversion.
Comfort with effective-dated and point-in-time reporting: producing a correct view of the book as at a given date from a live transactional schema, including the treatment of mid-term adjustments and pro-rata earned premium.
Experience designing entitlement models for external users, particularly across broker, agency, and delegated authority hierarchies where a user may see their own book, their agency’s book, or a ceded share only.
Experience delivering reporting in a multi-tenant environment, and a view on when to isolate clients into separate workspaces and semantic models versus sharing a model secured by row-level security.
The following will be an advantage but not a minimum requirement:
Microsoft PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) certification.
Experience with Power BI Embedded and the app-owns-data pattern: service principal authentication, embed token generation, and passing an effective identity so that security is enforced for users who hold no Power BI licence.
Object-level security, dynamic data masking, or comparable techniques for concealing sensitive columns and tables.
Experience with Power BI paginated reports (Report Builder / RDL) or SSRS, for operational and pixel-perfect outputs such as bordereaux, statements, and schedules.
Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels, Power BI audit and activity logging, tenant settings, and periodic access reviews.
Awareness of data residency and cross-border transfer considerations across UK and South African client bases.
Version control of Power BI artefacts (PBIP / TMDL in Git) and use of tools such as Tabular Editor, DAX Studio, and the Best Practice Analyzer.
Exposure to the Azure data stack (Azure SQL, Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric), as the reporting architecture is expected to evolve over time.
Experience in a SaaS or software implementation environment supporting multiple concurrent clients
SKILLS AND BEHAVIOUR REQUIRED
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with attention to detail and data accuracy.
Ability to translate business and client requirements into effective technical BI solutions.
Pragmatic about where logic belongs, with sound judgement on whether a calculation is best solved in T-SQL, Power Query, or DAX.
A security-first mindset, treating client data confidentiality as non-negotiable and defaulting to least privilege rather than convenience.
Clear communicator, able to present data insights and explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Mindful of the operational impact of reporting workloads on shared infrastructure, and disciplined about query cost and refresh timing.
Strong time management, able to prioritise and deliver across multiple concurrent projects and reporting requests.
Collaborative team player who works effectively with development, implementation, database, security, and client-facing teams.
Self-managed and proactive, with sound judgement on when to escalate risks or blockers.

descriptions.title: Senior/Lead Power Platform Developer (Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse) (Remote
descriptions.description:
DataFin was established in 1999. We pride ourselves on the fact that we have established relationships with industry leaders and a vast majority of our business is repeat business.

Duties & Responsibilities

ENVIRONMENT:
Our client is currently seeking a Senior Power Platform Developer.  This role sits at the point where the Microsoft 365 estate, the Power Platform and conversational AI meet. You will design and build business applications on Power Apps and Power Automate, and you will design and ship the agents that sit on top of them in Copilot Studio. They are looking for someone who thinks in terms of enterprise architecture rather than individual applications. The work involves deciding where a process belongs, which parts of the Microsoft 365 and Azure stack should carry it, how data flows between them, and how the whole thing is governed once it is live. Building the solution is a large part of the job, but so is the reasoning that precedes it. Copilot Studio is a central skillset for this position, not a peripheral one. A meaningful share of their current pipeline work involves agents that act on enterprise data and trigger real business processes, and they need someone who has taken that kind of work into production rather than only through a proof of concept.
DUTIES:
Solution and enterprise architecture
Assess business processes and decide what belongs in the Power Platform, what belongs in Microsoft 365, what
belongs in Azure, and what should not be built at all.
Define environment strategy across development, test and production, including Dataverse provisioning, environment groups and managed environments.
Design the data model, starting with Dataverse tables, relationships, business rules and calculated columns, and
extending to integration with systems of record outside the platform.
Define the security model, covering Dataverse security roles, business units, teams, column level security and
hierarchy security and align it to Entra ID groups.
Set and enforce data loss prevention policies, connector governance and tenant level guardrails, typically through a Centre of Excellence pattern.
Advise clients on licensing and capacity, including the cost implications of Premium connectors, Dataverse storage, Copilot Studio messages and Power Platform requests.
Copilot Studio
Design, build and deploy custom agents in Copilot Studio for internal and client facing use cases.
Author topics and conversational flows and decide deliberately where to use authored topics and where to rely on generative orchestration.
Ground agents in enterprise knowledge, including SharePoint, Dataverse, public and internal websites, and file based sources, and tune retrieval quality rather than accepting the default behaviour.
Build actions that let agents do work rather than only answer questions, using connectors, Power Automate flows, agent flows, custom APIs and Model Context Protocol servers.
Implement authentication correctly, including Entra ID single sign on and user context propagation, so that an agent only ever returns what the requesting user is entitled to see.
Deploy agents across the right channels, most commonly Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint and web.
Test, evaluate and improve agent behaviour over time, using analytics, conversation transcripts, escalation rates and topic level performance to drive changes.
Apply responsible AI practice, including scope limits, refusal behaviour, escalation to a human, and clear communication to users about what the agent can and cannot do.
Extend agents into Microsoft 365 Copilot where appropriate, including declarative agents and connected knowledge
Power Apps
Build canvas applications with well-structured Power Fx, reusable components and a considered approach to delegation and performance against large data sources.
Build model driven applications on Dataverse, including forms, views, business process flows and command bar customisation.
Develop custom components with the Power Apps Component Framework where the out of the box controls are not sufficient.
Design interfaces that people will actually use, including responsive layouts, accessibility and offline behaviour where the scenario calls for it.
Power Automate
Build cloud flows for approvals, integration, scheduled processing and event driven automation.
Build desktop flows for robotic process automation against systems that offer no API.
Develop custom connectors for internal and third party APIs.
Apply error handling, retry policy, concurrency control and monitoring, so that failures are visible and recoverable rather than silent.
Microsoft 365 and integration
Integrate solutions with SharePoint Online, Teams, Exchange and OneDrive.
Use Microsoft Graph where the platform connectors fall short.
Integrate with Azure services such as Azure Functions, API Management, Logic Apps, Service Bus and Azure OpenAI where a requirement exceeds what the platform provides natively.
Application lifecycle management
Manage solutions properly, including managed and unmanaged solution strategy, solution layering and environment variables.
Build deployment pipelines using Power Platform pipelines or Azure DevOps, with source control and automated deployment rather than manual export and import.
Maintain documentation that allows a client team to take ownership after handover.
Leadership
At Lead level, you will additionally own the technical direction of an engagement, review the work of other developers, set standards for the team, and act as the primary technical point of contact for the client.
REQUIREMENTS:
Core skills
Enterprise architecture
Microsoft 365
Microsoft Power Platform
Power Apps, both canvas and model driven
Power Automate, including cloud flows and desktop flows
Copilot Studio, including agent design, knowledge grounding, actions and deployment
Dataverse data modelling and security
Power Fx
Application lifecycle management and CI/CD for the Power Platform
Technologies
Microsoft Power Platform · Power Apps · Power Automate · Copilot Studio · Dataverse · Power Fx · Power Pages · Power BI ·Microsoft 365 · SharePoint Online · Microsoft Teams · Microsoft Graph · Entra ID · Azure Functions · Azure API Management · Azure DevOps · Git · MCP
Nice to have
Experience designing and delivering training, whether formal client enablement sessions, internal upskilling, or
structured handover to a client team at the end of an engagement. This carries real weight for us, because a large part of the value we leave behind is a client team that can operate and extend what they have built.
Relevant Microsoft certifications, for example the Power Platform Solution Architect, Power Platform Developer or Power Platform Functional Consultant tracks.
Experience establishing or running a Power Platform Centre of Excellence.
Experience with Power Pages for external facing portals.
Experience in a consulting or client facing delivery environment.
Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol and with agent patterns outside the Microsoft stack.
Traditional development background, for example C# or TypeScript, for the cases where the platform is not the right answer.
What they look for beyond the technology
The judgement to say when a low code solution is the wrong choice, and the ability to justify that position to a client who may have already decided otherwise.
Clear written communication. Much of the role is remote, and architectural decisions need to survive being read rather than explained in person.
A pragmatic view of AI. Agents are a strong fit for some problems and a poor fit for others, and they would rather hire someone who can tell the difference than someone who applies them everywhere.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Senior, Lead, Power, Platform, Developer, Power, Apps, Power, Automate, Copilot, Studio, Dataverse, Remote

descriptions.description:
Introduction

Our client is building the next generation of data, analytics and AI capabilities for the group. They believe technology should create Soft Landings: making work simpler, decisions smarter and businesses stronger.
Looking for a ML Engineer to be the dedicated engineering partner for their Data Science team. This is a dual-discipline role sitting at the intersection of data engineering and machine learning operations — purpose-built to ensure our Data Scientists have the data they need to build models, and that those models reliably reach production.

Duties & Responsibilities

PLEASE READ THIS CAREFULLY BEFORE APPLYING
This is not a platform maintenance role.
You'll work directly alongside three Data Scientists building feature pipelines, productionising models and establishing the engineering standards that make AI work in a regulated insurance environment. If you're a engineer who's comfortable moving between data infrastructure and ML delivery, and who thrives when their work creates measurable business outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.
This role supports the Data Science team
— not the core Data Engineering function
Your primary stakeholders are  Data Scientists. You are their dedicated engineering partner. You will collaborate with our Data Engineering team on platform standards and shared infrastructure, but you are not responsible for the core data modernisation delivery backlog. That boundary is intentional and will be maintained.
Structure
60% Data Engineering
— building and maintaining the pipelines, feature datasets and Snowflake data assets your Data Scientists need to train and validate models.
40% ML Ops
— taking models from experimentation into production: deployment, versioning, monitoring and drift detection. Both disciplines serve one team: Data Science.
01  Data Engineering for AI & Data Science
You'll build and own the data infrastructure that powers the Data Science team  ensuring they always have clean, reliable, well-structured data to work with.
Design and build feature pipelines and training datasets that support model development and validation
Build and maintain high-quality data assets in Snowflake that serve AI and analytical workloads
Collaborate with Data Engineering to align on platform standards without absorbing core modernisation backlog
Develop scalable feature engineering capabilities and contribute to feature management best practices
Ensure data pipelines supporting model training and inference are reliable, monitored and well-documented
Apply awareness of data governance and regulatory obligations (POPIA, FAIS, TCF) when building and managing data assets used in AI systems
Validate data quality and ensure model inputs align with agreed business definitions
02  ML Ops & Model Productionisation
You'll close the gap between data science experimentation and production  ensuring models built by the team reach the business reliably and at scale.
Partner with Data Scientists to productionise machine learning models and AI solutions
Design, build and maintain ML deployment pipelines and model serving infrastructure
Implement CI/CD practices for machine learning workflows and automated model delivery
Manage model versioning, experiment tracking and reproducible deployments
Monitor deployed models for performance, data drift, reliability and operational health
Ensure model outputs, data lineage and deployment decisions are documented and auditable
Contribute to responsible AI practices — explainability, monitoring and model risk controls
Troubleshoot production issues and continuously improve model and pipeline performance
03  Engineering Standards & Collaboration
You will help establish the engineering rigour that makes AI work trustworthy and sustainable — across the Data Science team and the broader Data & AI function.
Help establish ML engineering standards and best practices for the Data Science team
Contribute to the architecture of our growing AI ecosystem across Azure and GCP environments
Work with Analytics Engineers to integrate ML outputs into analytical and operational data products
Identify opportunities to improve automation, tooling and delivery velocity across the AI workstream
Proactively flag data, model or infrastructure risks before they become production issues
We're not building another data team. We're building a modern AI and data organisation where engineering, science and business knowledge come together to solve real problems in a regulated, commercially meaningful environment.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Be the go-to engineering partner for a high-performing Data Science team
Work with modern technologies including Azure, Snowflake, Python and dbt
Help shape our ML platform and productionisation standards from the ground up
See your engineering work translate directly into production AI that creates business value
Influence our AI ecosystem architecture as it scales across two insurance entities
Continuously learn and grow as AI and ML engineering evolve
Help build intelligent systems that improve how an insurance business operates every day
If you want a generalist platform role with no clear ownership, this probably isn't it.
If you want to be the engineering engine behind a Data Science team building real AI in insurance — we'd love to hear from you.
The division exists to accelerate sustainable growth through intelligent technologies, delivering Soft Landings for businesses, people and communities. They combine business expertise, data engineering, analytics, automation and AI to help organisations make smarter decisions, move faster and grow with confidence.
Intelligent Growth — build learning systems that scale wisely
Collaborative Intelligence — connect people, systems and insights to make better decisions
Trust by Design — create solutions that are explainable, ethical and reliable
Soft Landings — use technology to make change feel supported, safe and sustainable
Location & Working Arrangement
On-site | George, Western Cape — Hybrid Negotiable
This role is primarily based on-site at our George office. We're a collaborative, high-energy team and in-person presence is core to how we work. Hybrid arrangements may be considered for the right candidate — this is a conversation we're open to at offer stage. Applicants based in or willing to relocate to George are strongly encouraged to apply.

Desired Experience & Qualification

5+ years' experience in ML Engineering, Data Engineering or a combined role
Proven track record taking ML models from experimentation into production
Strong Python skills for pipeline development, ML workflows and automation
SQL proficiency for data investigation, transformation and validation
Experience with Azure cloud services and infrastructure
Snowflake or equivalent cloud data warehouse
CI/CD pipeline development and version control (Git)
Docker and containerisation for ML and data workloads
Model monitoring, drift detection and observability practices
Feature engineering building datasets that reliably serve model training
Awareness of data governance and regulatory requirements (POPIA, FAIS context)
Strong software engineering fundamentals and production development practices
Advantegious
Exposure to dbt for data transformation workflows
Databricks
Feature store design and management
API development and ML model serving endpoints
Insurance or financial services experience
Looking for someone who is:
Senior enough to hold two disciplines simultaneously without dropping either under pressure
A builder who takes ownership and follows work through to production
Collaborative and comfortable working as the dedicated engineering partner to a Data Science team
Pragmatic someone who finds the right solution for the problem, not the most complex one
Naturally curious about AI, ML and emerging engineering technologies

We’re looking for a passionate a Data Warehouse Engineer (SQL Server + Python) that will build and automates data warehouse solutions using SQL Server and Python, with exposure to Microsoft Fabric as an emerging analytics platform. This role will improve reliability and automation of DW delivery through scripted ETL/ELT, data-quality checks, and audit logging, and supports gradual Fabric adoption by integrating Python workflows where applicable.
This is a full-on-site vacancy situated in Centurion.
What
Hello Group
Offers
Onsite Barista
– Because life’s too short for bad coffee!
Exciting Team Events
– Work hard, play harder!
Teambuilding Activities
– Get to know your teammates beyond the screen!
A Culture That Feels Like Family
– No corporate robots here—just real people doing great things!
A Top-Notch Office Space
– Where inspiration meets innovation
Please note: If you have heard back from us for vetting purposes, please take your application as unsuccessful, and that you have not met the required criteria.

Duties & Responsibilities

1. SQL Server DW Development
Develop and maintain SQL Server DW structures (tables, views, stored procedures) in line with team standards (Sandbox → Extract → Transform). Support DWIntake-driven delivery including source onboarding, target naming, schedules, and production handover.
2. Python ETL/ELT Automation
Automate ETL/ELT processes using Python (pandas, pyodbc, SQLAlchemy). Build reusable scripts for extracts, transforms, loads, file/API ingestion, and scheduled jobs with robust connectivity, failure handling, and recoverable run design.
3. Data Quality & Audit Logging
Implement data-quality checks in Python scripts and pipelines to prevent bad data landing in the DW. Design audit logging so runs are recoverable, traceable, and reviewable. Support Table Compare and monitoring workflows for assigned datasets.
4. Fabric Enablement
Contribute to Fabric adoption by integrating Python workflows where applicable (notebooks, orchestration helpers, validation scripts). Collaborate with Fabric-focused colleagues on parity, testing, and handoff between SQL Server and Fabric artefacts.
5. Operational Support & Incidents
Respond to operational incidents for owned scripts and jobs. Escalate Finance vs DW ownership correctly. Maintain high reliability of owned scheduled processes.
6. Source Control & Collaboration
Use Git for all owned code with clear commit discipline and rollback paths. Collaborate with DW and BI teams; assist with onboarding on Python automation patterns used by the team.
7. Governance & Documentation
Apply DW governance practices: naming, documentation, and clear ownership of automated processes. Ensure production changes are traceable to intake/Jira references.
8. Stakeholder Delivery
Deliver assigned intake and automation work within agreed timelines. Communicate delays proactively and support BI/data availability queries timeously.

Desired Experience & Qualification

Education
National Diploma / Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or equivalent — OR equivalent demonstrable DW / data-engineering experience. Python / data-engineering certifications preferred. Microsoft Fabric or Azure Data training advantageous.
Experience
3–5 years SQL Server experience (T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, performance tuning). Minimum 1 year practical Python for data engineering (ETL/ELT automation, APIs; pandas, pyodbc / SQLAlchemy). Experience implementing data-quality checks and audit logging in scripts/pipelines. FinTech / high-volume transactional experience highly desirable.
Technical Knowledge
Strong SQL Server (SSMS / T-SQL). Proficiency in Python for data engineering. Git and scripting practices that support auditability and rollback. Solid DW concepts and governance. Preferred: Microsoft Fabric (pipelines, lakehouse, warehouse), cloud data integration tools, Power BI handoff.
Analytical Skills
Ability to diagnose script and SQL failures methodically, distinguish root cause from symptoms, and design checks that prevent bad data rather than fixing after the fact.
Communication
Clear verbal and written communication with DW, BI, and Finance stakeholders. Able to explain technical issues and timelines to non-specialists.
Work Style
Organised, audit-minded, and delivery-focused. Comfortable working in a small team with clear ownership. Able to prioritise under operational time pressure.
Systems Exposure
SQL Server; Python (pandas, pyodbc, SQLAlchemy); Git; ETL/ELT and data-quality frameworks; APIs; Microsoft Fabric (preferred); Hello Group DW tooling (DWIntake, Procedure Monitor, Table Compare) as applicable.

Chartered Management Services is the operational backbone of Chartered Wealth Group, providing the shared services, support and infrastructure that enable Chartered Wealth Solutions and our related businesses to deliver thoughtful, relationship-led service. As one of South Africa’s leading independent financial planning practices, our work depends on the trust placed in us by our clients, colleagues and partners. We handle sensitive client, company and employee information every day, and we are committed to protecting it with the same care and integrity that guide everything we do.
We are looking for a Data Governance and Security Specialist to help strengthen how information is managed, protected and governed across the business. Reporting to the Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of technology, compliance and business operations, helping to ensure that data is stored, shared and accessed in a way that is secure, practical and aligned with the needs of the business.
This role is well suited to someone who enjoys solving complex problems, balancing security requirements with business realities, and helping create an environment where people can work confidently and responsibly with information. Your contribution will help shape a more secure, consistent and trusted digital workplace for colleagues, clients and the broader business.

Support and maintain data governance practices across Chartered's systems, repositories and digital environment.
Drive the classification, labelling and protection of company, client and employee information.
Implement and monitor data loss prevention, information protection and security controls.
Support secure information sharing through appropriate access, authorisation and monitoring controls.
Monitor cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities and incidents in collaboration with internal teams and external providers.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of Microsoft security, governance and compliance platforms.
Maintain and review information security, cybersecurity and data governance policies and processes.
Work closely with Compliance and business stakeholders to ensure governance requirements remain practical and aligned with regulatory obligations.

Identify opportunities to strengthen controls, improve user experience and reduce organisational risk.

Matric (required)

Experience working with Microsoft 365 administration and security across Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Outlook, Entra ID, Azure AD, Intune or endpoint management (required).
Experience supporting information protection, sensitivity labelling, access management, security monitoring, audit reviews or incident response (required).

Translate reporting, accounting and operational requirements into practical finance-data structures.

Maintain traceability between business requirements, design decisions and implementation outcomes.
Document key decisions, assumptions, dependencies and unresolved matters.

Establish approval workflows and governance forums.
Define finance master-data maintenance procedures.
Develop data-quality standards and control frameworks.

Identify design risks, dependencies, impacts and implementation considerations.
Validate that proposed technology solutions support the approved finance design.
Define transition and implementation roadmaps.
Support the development of the finance data-migration strategy.

Support testing, training, change management and business-readiness activities.
Provide subject-matter expertise throughout the transformation lifecycle.
Ensure that all proposed designs are practical, controlled and implementable.

A comprehensive future-state Finance Data Model blueprint
A detailed future-state Chart of Accounts
Reporting dimensions, attributes, hierarchies and roll-up structures
Finance data-design principles and standards
A Finance Data Governance and ownership framework

A current-to-future Chart of Accounts mapping strategy
Data-migration requirements and design principles
Reporting, process, system and control impact assessments

Strong experience designing finance data models that support multiple legal entities, business units, products and reporting requirements.

Experience producing detailed design documentation and implementation roadmaps.

descriptions.title: Business Analyst
descriptions.description:
Reference: PE011733-LM-1
Overview:
The Business Analyst is responsible for delivering high-quality business analysis services across multiple, concurrent software application development initiatives, with a strong emphasis on innovation, digital transformation, and system modernisation. The role serves as a critical bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring that business needs are effectively translated into scalable, future-fit technology solutions. The incumbent will play a key role in driving modernisation efforts, including the replacement or enhancement of legacy systems, introduction of new digital capabilities, and optimisation of business processes through technology. The Business Analyst is expected to contribute to continuous improvement and innovation by identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, enable automation, improve user experience, and support data-driven decision-making. This includes actively participating in solution ideation, evaluating emerging technologies, and contributing to the design of modern, integrated, and sustainable application architectures.
Working across multiple projects simultaneously, the incumbent will:
Facilitate the alignment of business strategy with technology delivery
Ensure requirements are aligned to enterprise architecture standards and modernisation roadmaps
Promote best practices in business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration
The role requires a highly experienced professional who is capable of operating in complex, high-impact environments, delivering analysis that supports innovative solutions and long-term digital transformation objectives, while maintaining strong governance, quality, and traceability standards.
Key responsibilities:
Lead business analysis across multiple concurrent projects.
Elicit, analyse, and document business and system requirements.
Produce high-quality documentation including Business Requirements Documents, Functional Specifications, User Stories and Process Maps.
Facilitate stakeholder workshops and engagement sessions.
Translate business requirements into functional specifications for development teams.
Support SDLC phases including design, development, testing and UAT.
Support the UAT process by providing guidance and clarifying requirement ambiguities.
Maintain requirements traceability.
Conduct gap analysis and process improvement activities.
Analyse and map current and future-state business processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
Facilitate process redesign and optimisation initiatives aligned with business objectives and technology solutions.
Define process measures, controls, and performance indicators to support continuous improvement.
Key deliverables:
Business and functional requirements documentation.
Process maps and workflow diagrams.
Stakeholder engagement outputs.
Traceability matrices and UAT support artefacts.
Governance, risk and compliance:
Ensure all processes align with organisational governance, compliance, and audit standards.
Maintain audit-ready documentation for process changes and digital initiatives.
Support internal and external audits by providing process evidence, metrics, and controls.
Embed quality, risk management, and controls into process design.
Requirements:
Qualifications and experience:
Relevant Degree / Diploma in IT, Business Analysis, Information Systems; OR Matric with 10 years’ experience and a recognised Business Analysis certification (CBAP, CCBA, PMI-PBA).
Minimum 10 years’ relevant Business Analysis experience within Software Application Development environments.
Process Engineering background and experience would be beneficial and preferred.
Proven experience working on multiple projects simultaneously.
Required skills and competencies:
Strong documentation and requirements specification skills.
Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
Innovation-driven, with a demonstrated ability to develop practical, future-focused solutions.
Experience with Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
Proficiency in tools such as JIRA, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Visio.
Behavioural competencies:
Attention to detail.
Strong interpersonal skills.
Ability to work under pressure.
Self-driven and accountable.
Collaborative team player.

Our well established client in Johannesburg is seeking a Business Analyst — Office of the Group Managing Director.
What the role entails:
60–70% analysis, reporting and project follow-through — branch and category performance, margin and mix analysis, lead-time and process diagnostics & exco commitments to closure.
20–30% agenda and governance
10–20% classic PA work — diary, travel, etc.
Executive Reporting:
Prepare, consolidate and quality-assure monthly Group reporting. Manage the reporting calendar, coordinate inputs and ensure all information is accurate, concise and delivered within agreed deadlines.
Business & Performance Analysis:
Analyse branch, category and representative-level performance across sales, gross margin, product mix and expenses. Identify key variances, trends and underlying drivers, and translate findings into clear, actionable insights for the Group Managing Director.
Operational & Process Diagnostics:
Investigate operational performance and identify root causes across the end-to-end process, including quote-to-invoice, open-order ageing, lead times, order flow and manufacturing throughput. Develop practical, quantified recommendations to improve performance.
Project & Action Follow-Through:
Maintain visibility of commitments arising from EXCO, management and Group MD meetings. Track actions against clear owners and deadlines, follow up on outstanding items and escalate potential delays or risks before they become issues.

Provide analytical support for pricing decisions, campaigns, tenders, customer profitability and other key commercial initiatives. Develop the financial and operational analysis required to support sound business decisions.

Ensure the Group Managing Director is fully prepared for key meetings, customer engagements, discussions and leadership forums by providing the relevant information, analysis, briefing material and key questions in advance.
Executive Administration:
Manage the Group MD's diary, travel arrangements, inbox, meeting coordination with a high level of professionalism, discretion and efficiency, ensuring administrative matters are handled proactively.
Cross-Functional Engagement:
Work closely with finance, sales, operations, manufacturing, branches and other business functions to gather information, understand issues and drive initiatives through to completion.

descriptions.title: Software Developer (GraphQL Focus)
descriptions.description:
Introduction

The Software Developer (GraphQL Focus) is a domain-specialized software engineer responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing unified GraphQL API layers to streamline data consumption across diverse web and mobile platforms. Operating at the direct intersection of client-side user experience, backend microservices, and enterprise data graph orchestration, this developer acts as a bridge engineer who eliminates data over-fetching/under-fetching and standardizes frontend-to-backend data delivery. The position requires a focused developer with expert knowledge of schema definition languages, resolver execution logic, and graph federations, alongside a deep understanding of frontend state management.

Duties & Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain clean, extendable GraphQL schemas, custom types, mutations, subscriptions, and directive definitions across client applications.
Write, test, and optimize asynchronous resolver functions that seamlessly bind GraphQL endpoints to underlying microservices, REST APIs, and direct database layers.
Implement graph federation solutions (e.g. Apollo Federation) and schema stitching to consolidate disparate backend services into a single, unified data graph.
Diagnose and resolve problem and resource exhaustion risks using batching, caching strategies, and tools like DataLoader and Redis.
Configure, monitor, and enforce query complexity analysis, depth limiting, and field-level access control to protect the GraphQL engine against denial-of-service threats.
Collaborate directly with React, React Native, Angular, and mobile application teams to structure query schemas aligned precisely with client state requirements.
Maintain comprehensive schema documentation, interactive playground environments, and developer tooling to simplify frontend team onboarding and adoption.
Continuously monitor and profile GraphQL engine operations, tracing query field execution latencies and optimizing payload transport efficiency.
Implement client-side and server-side caching policies (Apollo Client / Relay) to minimize redundant network round-trips and optimize offline data handling.
Participate actively in agile ceremonies, providing accurate task estimations, schema design reviews, and continuous improvement inputs within Jira.

Desired Experience & Qualification

National Diploma, Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field.
A minimum of 3 to 5 years of commercial software development experience, with at least 2+ years dedicated hands-on experience building production GraphQL layers.
Mastery of the modern GraphQL stack, including Apollo Server/Client, GraphQL Java, Hasura, Prisma, or TypeGraphQL, using TypeScript/Node.js or Java.
Relevant cloud or developer certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Developer, Apollo GraphQL Developer Certification) are advantageous.
Experience in IT Consulting or Telecommunications domains will be advantageous.
In-depth understanding of API paradigms, contrasting GraphQL with REST, gRPC, and SOAP architectures in terms of performance and network overhead.
Demonstrated proficiency using DataLoader, Redis, and query caching implementations to eliminate performance bottlenecks in graph traversal.
Solid experience integrating GraphQL layers with modern frontend frameworks (React, Next.js, React Native, or Angular) and state management libraries.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset, with a proven ability to isolate execution bottlenecks across multi-layered distributed query graphs.
Excellent collaborative and communication skills, with a track record of creating clear schema documentation and establishing smooth developer workflows between teams.

Distributed between the two sites, SAAO employs roughly 130 people, many of them scientists and engineers, and is contracted to operate the 10-m Southern African Large Telescope (SALT), on behalf of the international SALT Foundation. The position is within a dynamic division, comprised of approximately three dozen staff, including astronomers, electrical, electronic, optical and mechanical engineers, technicians, and software developers.

Work closely with engineers and multidisciplinary teams

Problem-solving mindset and adaptability
